sections.label: A charm to recover a dying man
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 1

verses.sa:
अन्तकाय मृत्यवे नमः प्राणा अपाना इह ते रमन्ताम्।
इहायमस्तु पुरुषः सहासुना सूर्यस्य भागे अमृतस्य लोके॥
verses.tr: antakāya mṛtyave namaḥ prāṇā apānā iha te ramantām ihāyamastu puruṣaḥ sahāsunā sūryasya bhāge amṛtasya loke
verses.en: Homage to Death the Ender! May thy breathings, inward and outward, still remain within thee. Here stay this man united with his spirit in the Sun's realm, the world of life eternal!

verses.sa:
उदेनं भगो अग्रभीदुदेनं सोमो अंशुमान्।
उदेनं मरुतो देवा उदिन्द्राग्नी स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: udenaṃ bhago agrabhīdudenaṃ somo aṃśumān udenaṃ maruto devā udindrāgnī svastaye
verses.en: Bhaga hath lifted up this man, and Soma with his filaments, Indra and Agni, and the Gods the Maruts, raised him up to health.

verses.sa:
इह तेऽसुरिह प्राण इहायुरिह ते मनः ।
उत् त्वा निरृत्याः पाशेभ्यो दैव्या वाचा भरामसि॥
verses.tr: iha te'suriha prāṇa ihāyuriha te manaḥ ut tvā nirṛtyāḥ pāśebhyo daivyā vācā bharāmasi
verses.en: Here is thy spirit, here thy breath, here is thy life, here is thy soul: By a celestial utterance we raise thee from Destruction's bonds.

verses.sa:
उत् क्रामातः पुरुष माव पत्था मृत्योः पड्वीषमवमुञ्चमानः ।
मा च्छित्था अस्माल्लोकादग्नेः सूर्यस्य संदृशः॥
verses.tr: ut krāmātaḥ puruṣa māva patthā mṛtyoḥ paḍvīṣamavamuñcamānaḥ mā cchitthā asmāllokādagneḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśaḥ
verses.en: Up from this place, O man, rise! sink not downward, casting away the bonds of Death that hold thee. Be not thou parted from this world, from sight of Agni and the Sun.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं वातः पवतां मातरिश्वा तुभ्यं वर्षन्त्वमृतान्यापः ।
सूर्यस्ते तन्वे३शं तपाति त्वां मृत्युर्दयतां मा प्र मेष्ठाः॥
उद्यानं ते पुरुष नावयानं जीवातुं ते दक्षतातिं कृणोमि ।
आ हि रोहेमममृतं सुखं रथमथ जिर्विर्विदथमा वदासि॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ mātariśvā tubhyaṃ varṣantvamṛtānyāpaḥ sūryaste tanve3śaṃ tapāti tvāṃ mṛtyurdayatāṃ mā pra meṣṭhāḥ udyānaṃ te puruṣa nāvayānaṃ jīvātuṃ te dakṣatātiṃ kṛṇomi ā hi rohemamamṛtaṃ sukhaṃ rathamatha jirvirvidathamā vadāsi
verses.en: Purely for thee breathe Wind and Matarisvan, and let the Waters rain on thee their nectar. The Sun shall shine with healing on thy body; Death shall have mercy on thee: do not leave us! Upward must be thy way, O man, not downward: with life and mental vigour I endow thee. Ascend this car eternal, lightly rolling; then full of years shalt thou address the meeting.

verses.sa:
मा ते मनस्तत्र गान्मा तिरो भून्मा जीवेभ्यः प्र मदो मानु गाः पितॄन्।
विश्वे देवा अभि रक्षन्तु त्वेह॥
verses.tr: mā te manastatra gānmā tiro bhūnmā jīvebhyaḥ pra mado mānu gāḥ pitṝn viśve devā abhi rakṣantu tveha
verses.en: Let not thy soul go thither, nor be lost to us: slight not the living, go not where the Fathers are. Let all the Gods retain thee here in safety.

verses.sa:
मा गतानामा दीधीथा ये नयन्ति परावतम्।
आ रोह तमसो ज्योतिरेह्या ते हस्तौ रभामहे॥
verses.tr: mā gatānāmā dīdhīthā ye nayanti parāvatam ā roha tamaso jyotirehyā te hastau rabhāmahe
verses.en: Yearn not for the departed ones, for those who lead men far away. Rise up from darkness into light: come, both thy hands we clasp in ours.

verses.sa:
श्यामश्च त्वा मा शबलश्च प्रेषितौ यमस्य यौ पथिरक्षी श्वानौ ।
अर्वाङेहि मा वि दीध्यो मात्र तिष्ठः पराङ्मनाः॥
verses.tr: śyāmaśca tvā mā śabalaśca preṣitau yamasya yau pathirakṣī śvānau arvāṅehi mā vi dīdhyo mātra tiṣṭhaḥ parāṅmanāḥ
verses.en: Let not the black dog and the brindled seize thee, two warders of the way sent forth by Yama. Come hither; do not hesitate: with mind averted stay not there.

verses.sa:
मैतं पन्थामनु गा भीम एष येन पूर्वं नेयथ तं ब्रवीमि ।
तम एतत् पुरुष मा प्र पत्था भयं परस्तादभयं ते अर्वाक्॥
verses.tr: maitaṃ panthāmanu gā bhīma eṣa yena pūrvaṃ neyatha taṃ bravīmi tama etat puruṣa mā pra patthā bhayaṃ parastādabhayaṃ te arvāk
verses.en: Forbear to tread this path, for it is awful: that path I speak of which thou hast not travelled. Enter it not, O man; this way is darkness: forward is danger, hitherward is safety.

verses.sa:
रक्षन्तु त्वाग्नयो ये अप्स्व१न्ता रक्षतु त्वा मनुष्या३ यमिन्धते ।
वैश्वानरो रक्षतु जातवेदा दिव्यस्त्वा मा प्र धाग् विद्युता सह॥
verses.tr: rakṣantu tvāgnayo ye apsva1ntā rakṣatu tvā manuṣyā3 yamindhate vaiśvānaro rakṣatu jātavedā divyastvā mā pra dhāg vidyutā saha
verses.en: Thy guardians be the Fires within the Waters, thy guardian be the Fire which men enkindle. Thy guardian be Vaisvanara Jatavedas: let not celestial Fire with lightning burn thee.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा क्रव्यादभि मंस्तारात् संकसुकाच्चर।
रक्षतु त्वा द्यौ रक्षतु पृथिवी सूर्यश्च त्वा रक्षतां चन्द्रमाश्च ।
अन्तरिक्षं रक्षतु देवहेत्याः॥
verses.tr: mā tvā kravyādabhi maṃstārāt saṃkasukāccara rakṣatu tvā dyau rakṣatu pṛthivī sūryaśca tvā rakṣatāṃ candramāśca antarikṣaṃ rakṣatu devahetyāḥ
verses.en: Let not the Flesh-consumer plot against thee: depart thou far away from the Destroyer. Be Heaven and Earth and Sun and Moon thy keepers, and from the dart of Gods may Air protect thee.

verses.sa:
बोधश्च त्वा प्रतिबोधश्च रक्षतामस्वप्नश्च त्वानवद्राणश्च रक्षताम्।
गोपायंश्च त्वा जागृविश्च रक्षताम्॥
verses.tr: bodhaśca tvā pratibodhaśca rakṣatāmasvapnaśca tvānavadrāṇaśca rakṣatām gopāyaṃśca tvā jāgṛviśca rakṣatām
verses.en: May Vigilance and Watchfulness protect thee, Sleepless and Slumberless keep guard above thee! Let Guardian and let Wakeful be thy warders.

verses.sa: ते त्वा रक्षन्तु ते त्वा गोपायन्तु तेभ्यो नमस्तेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: te tvā rakṣantu te tvā gopāyantu tebhyo namastebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Let these be thy preservers, these thy keepers. All hail to these, to these be lowly worship!

verses.sa:
जीवेभ्यस्त्वा समुद्रे वायुरिन्द्रो धाता दधातु सविता त्रायमाणः ।
मा त्वा प्राणो बलं हासीदसुं तेऽनु ह्वयामसि॥
verses.tr: jīvebhyastvā samudre vāyurindro dhātā dadhātu savitā trāyamāṇaḥ mā tvā prāṇo balaṃ hāsīdasuṃ te'nu hvayāmasi
verses.en: May saving Savitar, Vayu, Indra, Dhatar restore thee to communion with the living. Let not thy vigour or thy breath forsake thee: we recall thy life.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा जम्भः संहनुर्मा तमो विदन्मा जिह्वा बर्हिः प्रमयुः कथा स्याः ।
उत् त्वादित्या वसवो भरन्तूदिन्द्राग्नी स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: mā tvā jambhaḥ saṃhanurmā tamo vidanmā jihvā barhiḥ pramayuḥ kathā syāḥ ut tvādityā vasavo bharantūdindrāgnī svastaye
verses.en: Let not the fiend with snapping jaws, nor darkness find thee: tongue, holy grass: how shouldst thou perish? May the Adityas and the Vasus, Indra and Agni raise thee and to health restore thee.

verses.sa:
उत् त्वा द्यौरुत् पृथिव्युत् प्रजापतिरग्रभीत्।
उत् त्वा मृत्योरोषधयः सोमराज्ञीरपीपरन्॥
verses.tr: ut tvā dyaurut pṛthivyut prajāpatiragrabhīt ut tvā mṛtyoroṣadhayaḥ somarājñīrapīparan
verses.en: The Sky hth raised thee, and the Earth, Prajapati hath raised thee up. The Plants and Herbs with Soma as their King have rescued thee from Death.

verses.sa:
अयं देवा इहैवास्त्वयं मामुत्र गादितः ।
इमं सहस्रवीर्येण मृत्योरुत् पारयामसि॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ devā ihaivāstvayaṃ māmutra gāditaḥ imaṃ sahasravīryeṇa mṛtyorut pārayāmasi
verses.en: Here let this man, O Gods, remain: let him not go to yonder world. We rescue him from Mrityu with a charm that hath a thousand powers.

verses.sa:
उत् त्वा मृत्योरपीपरं सं धमन्तु वयोधसः ।
मा त्वा व्यस्तकेश्यो३मा त्वाघरुदो रुदन्॥
verses.tr: ut tvā mṛtyorapīparaṃ saṃ dhamantu vayodhasaḥ mā tvā vyastakeśyo3mā tvāgharudo rudan
verses.en: I have delivered thee from Death. Strength-givers smelt and fashion thee! Let not she-fiends with wild loose locks, or fearful howlers yell at thee.

verses.sa:
आहार्षमविदं त्वा पुनरागाः पुनर्णवः ।
सर्वाङ्ग सर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वमायुश्च ते ऽविदम्॥
verses.tr: āhārṣamavidaṃ tvā punarāgāḥ punarṇavaḥ sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvamāyuśca te 'vidam
verses.en: I have attained and captured thee: thou hast returned restored to youth, Perfect in body: so have I found all thy sight and all thy life.

verses.sa:
व्यऽवात् ते ज्योतिरभूदप त्वत्तमो अक्रमीत्।
अप त्वन्मृत्युं निरृतिमप यक्ष्मं नि दध्मसि॥
verses.tr: vya'vāt te jyotirabhūdapa tvattamo akramīt apa tvanmṛtyuṃ nirṛtimapa yakṣmaṃ ni dadhmasi
verses.en: Life hath breathed on thee; light hath come: darkness hath past away from thee. Far from thee we have buried Death, buried Destruction and Decline.

sections.label: A charm to recover a dying man
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 2

verses.sa:
आ रभस्वेमाममृतस्य श्नुष्टिमच्छिद्यमाना जरदष्टिरस्तु ते ।
असुं त आयुः पुनरा भरामि रजस्तमो मोप गा मा प्र मेष्ठाः॥
verses.tr: ā rabhasvemāmamṛtasya śnuṣṭimacchidyamānā jaradaṣṭirastu te asuṃ ta āyuḥ punarā bharāmi rajastamo mopa gā mā pra meṣṭhāḥ
verses.en: Seize to thyself this trust of life for ever: thine be longevity which nothing shortens. Thy spirit and thy life again I bring thee: die not, nor vanish into mist and darkness.

verses.sa:
जीवतां ज्योतिरभ्येह्यर्वाङा त्वा हरामि शतशारदाय ।
अवमुञ्चन् मृत्युपाशानशस्तिं द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं ते दधामि॥
verses.tr: jīvatāṃ jyotirabhyehyarvāṅā tvā harāmi śataśāradāya avamuñcan mṛtyupāśānaśastiṃ drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ te dadhāmi
verses.en: Come to the light of living men, come hither: I draw thee to a life of hundred autumns. Loosing the bonds of Death, the curse that holds thee, I give thee age of very long duration.

verses.sa:
वातात् ते प्राणमविदं सूर्याच्चक्षुरहं तव ।
यत् ते मनस्त्वयि तद् धारयामि सं वित्स्वाङ्गैर्वद जिह्वयालपन्॥
verses.tr: vātāt te prāṇamavidaṃ sūryāccakṣurahaṃ tava yat te manastvayi tad dhārayāmi saṃ vitsvāṅgairvada jihvayālapan
verses.en: Thy breath have I recovered from the Wind, thy vision from the Sun. Thy mind I stablish and secure within thee: feel in thy members, use thy tongue, conversing.

verses.sa:
प्राणेन त्वा द्विपदां चतुष्पदामग्निमिव जातमभि सं धमामि ।
नमस्ते मृत्यो चक्षुषे नमः प्राणाय तेऽकरम्॥
verses.tr: prāṇena tvā dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāmagnimiva jātamabhi saṃ dhamāmi namaste mṛtyo cakṣuṣe namaḥ prāṇāya te'karam
verses.en: I blow upon thee with the breath of bipeds and quadrupeds, as on a fire new-kindled. To thee, O Death, and to thy sight and breath have I paid reverence.

verses.sa:
अयं जीवतु मा मृतेमं समीरयामसि ।
कृणोम्यस्मै भेषजं मृत्यो मा पुरुषं वधीः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ jīvatu mā mṛtemaṃ samīrayāmasi kṛṇomyasmai bheṣajaṃ mṛtyo mā puruṣaṃ vadhīḥ
verses.en: Let this man live, let him not die: we raise him, we recover him. I make for him a healing balm. O Death, forbear to slay this man.

verses.sa:
जीवलां नघारिषां जीवन्तीमोषधीमहम्।
त्रायमाणां सहमानां सहस्वतीमिह हुवेऽस्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: jīvalāṃ naghāriṣāṃ jīvantīmoṣadhīmaham trāyamāṇāṃ sahamānāṃ sahasvatīmiha huve'smā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Here for sound health I invocate a living animating plant, Preserving, queller of disease, victorious, full of power and might.

verses.sa:
अधि ब्रूहि मा रभथाः सृजेमं तवैव सन्त्सर्वहाया इहास्तु ।
भवाशर्वौ मृडतं शर्म यच्छतमपसिध्य दुरितं धत्तमायुः॥
verses.tr: adhi brūhi mā rabhathāḥ sṛjemaṃ tavaiva santsarvahāyā ihāstu bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ śarma yacchatamapasidhya duritaṃ dhattamāyuḥ
verses.en: Seize him not, but encourage and release him: here let him stay, though thine, in all his vigour. Bhava and Sarva, pity and protect him: give him full life and drive away misfortunes.

verses.sa:
अस्मै मृत्यो अधि ब्रूहीमं दयस्वोदितो३यमेतु ।
अरिष्टः सर्वाङ्गः सुश्रुज्जरसा शतहायन आत्मना भुजमश्नुताम्॥
verses.tr: asmai mṛtyo adhi brūhīmaṃ dayasvodito3yametu ariṣṭaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ suśrujjarasā śatahāyana ātmanā bhujamaśnutām
verses.en: Comfort him, Death, and pity him: let him arise and pass away. Unharmed, with all his members, hearing well, with eld, may he through hundred years win profit with his soul.

verses.sa:
देवानां हेतिः परि त्वा वृणक्तु पारयामि त्वा रजस उत् त्वा मृत्योरपीपरम्।
आरादग्निं क्रव्यादं निरूहं जीवातवे ते परिधिं दधामि॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ hetiḥ pari tvā vṛṇaktu pārayāmi tvā rajasa ut tvā mṛtyorapīparam ārādagniṃ kravyādaṃ nirūhaṃ jīvātave te paridhiṃ dadhāmi
verses.en: May the Gods' missile pass thee by. I bring thee safe from the mist: from death have I preserved thee. Far have I banished flesh-. -uniming Agni: I place a rampart for thy life's protection.

verses.sa:
यत् ते नियानं रजसं मृत्यो अनवधर्ष्यऽम्।
पथ इमं तस्माद् रक्षन्तो ब्रह्मास्मै वर्म कृण्मसि॥
verses.tr: yat te niyānaṃ rajasaṃ mṛtyo anavadharṣya'm patha imaṃ tasmād rakṣanto brahmāsmai varma kṛṇmasi
verses.en: Saving him from that misty path of thine which cannot be defied, From that descent of thine, O Death, we make for him a shield of prayer.

verses.sa:
कृणोमि ते प्राणापानौ जरां मृत्युं दीर्घमायुः स्वस्ति।
वैवस्वतेन प्रहितान् यमदूतांश्चरतोऽप सेधामि सर्वान्॥
verses.tr: kṛṇomi te prāṇāpānau jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ dīrghamāyuḥ svasti vaivasvatena prahitān yamadūtāṃścarato'pa sedhāmi sarvān
verses.en: I give thee both the acts of breath, health, lengthened life, and death by age. All Yama's messengers who roam around, sent by Vaivasvata, I chase away.

verses.sa:
आरादरातिं निरृतिं परो ग्राहिं क्रव्यादः पिशाचान्।
रक्षो यत् सर्वं दुर्भूतं तत् तम इवाप हन्मसि॥
verses.tr: ārādarātiṃ nirṛtiṃ paro grāhiṃ kravyādaḥ piśācān rakṣo yat sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ tat tama ivāpa hanmasi
verses.en: Far off we drive Malignity, Destruction, Pisachas banqueters on flesh, and Grahi. And all the demon kind, the brood of sin, like darkness, we dispel.

verses.sa:
अग्नेष्टे प्राणममृतादायुष्मतो वन्वे जातवेदसः ।
यथा न रिष्या अमृतः सजूरसस्तत् ते कृणोमि तदु ते समृध्यताम्॥
verses.tr: agneṣṭe prāṇamamṛtādāyuṣmato vanve jātavedasaḥ yathā na riṣyā amṛtaḥ sajūrasastat te kṛṇomi tadu te samṛdhyatām
verses.en: I win thy life from Agni, from the living everlasting Jatavedas. l This I procure for thee, that thou, undying, mayst not suffer harm, that thou mayst be content, that all be well with thee.

verses.sa:
शिवे ते स्तां द्यावापृथिवी असंतापे अभिश्रियौ ।
शं ते सूर्य आ तपतु शं वातो वातु ते हृदे।
शिवा अभि क्षरन्तु त्वापो दिव्याः पयस्वतीः॥
verses.tr: śive te stāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī asaṃtāpe abhiśriyau śaṃ te sūrya ā tapatu śaṃ vāto vātu te hṛde śivā abhi kṣarantu tvāpo divyāḥ payasvatīḥ
verses.en: Gracious to thee be Heaven and Earth, bringing no grief, and drawing nigh! Pleasantly shine the Sun for thee, the Wind blow sweetly to thy heart! Let the celestial Waters full of milk flow happily for thee.

verses.sa:
शिवास्ते सन्त्वोषधय उत् त्वाहार्षमधरस्या उत्तरां पृथिवीमभि।
तत्र त्वादित्यौ रक्षतां सूर्याचन्द्रमसावुभा॥
verses.tr: śivāste santvoṣadhaya ut tvāhārṣamadharasyā uttarāṃ pṛthivīmabhi tatra tvādityau rakṣatāṃ sūryācandramasāvubhā
verses.en: Auspicious be the Plants to thee! I have upraised. thee, borne thee from the lower to the upper earth: Let the two Sons of Aditi, the Sun and Moon, protect thee there.

verses.sa:
यत् ते वासः परिधानं यां नीविं कृणुषे त्वम्।
शिवं ते तन्वे३तत् कृण्मः संस्पर्शेऽद्रूक्ष्णमस्तु ते॥
verses.tr: yat te vāsaḥ paridhānaṃ yāṃ nīviṃ kṛṇuṣe tvam śivaṃ te tanve3tat kṛṇmaḥ saṃsparśe'drūkṣṇamastu te
verses.en: Whatever robe to cover thee or zone thou makest for thyself, We make it pleasant to thy frame: may it be soft and smooth to touch.

verses.sa:
यत् क्षुरेण मर्चयता सुतेजसा वप्ता वपसि केशश्मश्रु।
शुभं मुखं मा न आयुः प्र मोषीः॥
verses.tr: yat kṣureṇa marcayatā sutejasā vaptā vapasi keśaśmaśru śubhaṃ mukhaṃ mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ
verses.en: When, with a very keen and cleansing razor, our hair and beards thou shavest as a barber, Smoothing our free steal not our vital forces.

verses.sa:
शिवौ ते स्तां व्रीहियवावबलासावदोमधौ।
एतौ यक्ष्मं वि बाधेते एतौ मुञ्चतो अंहसः॥
verses.tr: śivau te stāṃ vrīhiyavāvabalāsāvadomadhau etau yakṣmaṃ vi bādhete etau muñcato aṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Auspicious unto thee be rice and barley, causing no painful sickness or consumption. These two expel consumption, these deliver from calamity.

verses.sa:
यदश्नासि यत् पिबसि धान्यंऽ कृष्याः पयः ।
यदाद्यं१ यदनाद्यं सर्वं ते अन्नमविषं कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: yadaśnāsi yat pibasi dhānyaṃ' kṛṣyāḥ payaḥ yadādyaṃ1 yadanādyaṃ sarvaṃ te annamaviṣaṃ kṛṇomi
verses.en: Thy food, thy drink, whatever they be, corn grown by cultivation, milk,—Food eatable, uneatable, I make all poisonless for thee.

verses.sa:
अह्ने च त्वा रात्रये चोभाभ्यां परि दद्मसि ।
अरायेभ्यो जिघत्सुभ्य इमं मे परि रक्षत॥
verses.tr: ahne ca tvā rātraye cobhābhyāṃ pari dadmasi arāyebhyo jighatsubhya imaṃ me pari rakṣata
verses.en: We give thee over as a charge to Day and Night, in trust to both. Keep him for me from sting)' fiends, from those who fain would feed on him.

verses.sa:
शतं तेऽयुतं हायनान् द्वे युगे त्रीणि चत्वारि कृण्मः ।
इन्द्राग्नी विश्वे देवास्तेऽनु मन्यन्तामहृणीयमानाः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ te'yutaṃ hāyanān dve yuge trīṇi catvāri kṛṇmaḥ indrāgnī viśve devāste'nu manyantāmahṛṇīyamānāḥ
verses.en: A hundred, yea, ten thousand years we give thee, ages two, three, four. May Indra, Agni, all the Gods, with willing favour look on thee.

verses.sa:
शरदे त्वा हेमन्ताय वसन्ताय ग्रीष्माय परि दद्मसि ।
वर्षाणि तुभ्यं स्योनानि येषु वर्धन्त ओषधीः॥
verses.tr: śarade tvā hemantāya vasantāya grīṣmāya pari dadmasi varṣāṇi tubhyaṃ syonāni yeṣu vardhanta oṣadhīḥ
verses.en: To Autumn we deliver thee, to Winter, Spring, and Summer's care. We trust thee with auspicious years wherein the plants and herbs grow up.

verses.sa:
मृत्युरीशे द्विपदां मृत्युरीशे चतुष्पदाम्।
तस्मात् त्वां मृत्योर्गोपतेरुद् भरामि स मा बिभेः॥
verses.tr: mṛtyurīśe dvipadāṃ mṛtyurīśe catuṣpadām tasmāt tvāṃ mṛtyorgopaterud bharāmi sa mā bibheḥ
verses.en: Death is the lord of bipeds, Death is sovran lord of quadrupeds. Away I bear thee from that: Death the ruler: be not thou afraid.

verses.sa:
सोऽरिष्ट न मरिष्यसि न मरिष्यसि मा बिभेः ।
न वै तत्र म्रियन्ते नो यन्त्यधमं तमः॥
verses.tr: so'riṣṭa na mariṣyasi na mariṣyasi mā bibheḥ na vai tatra mriyante no yantyadhamaṃ tamaḥ
verses.en: Thou, still uninjured, shalt not die: be not afraid; thou shalt not die. Here where I am men do not die or go to lowest depths of gloom.

verses.sa:
सर्वो वै तत्र जीवति गौरश्वः पुरुषः पशुः ।
यत्रेदं ब्रह्म क्रियते परिधिर्जीवनाय कम्॥
verses.tr: sarvo vai tatra jīvati gauraśvaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuḥ yatredaṃ brahma kriyate paridhirjīvanāya kam
verses.en: Here verily all creatures live, the cow, the horse, the man, the beast, Here where this holy prayer is used, a rampart that protecteth life. Let it preserve thee from thy peers, from incantation, from thy friends.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा पातु समानेभ्योऽभिचारात् सबन्धुभ्यः ।
अमम्रिर्भवामृतोऽतिजीवो मा ते हासिषुरसवः शरीरम्॥
verses.tr: pari tvā pātu samānebhyo'bhicārāt sabandhubhyaḥ amamrirbhavāmṛto'tijīvo mā te hāsiṣurasavaḥ śarīram
verses.en: Live very long, be healthy, be immortal: let not the vital breath forsake thy body.

verses.sa:
ये मृत्यव एकशतं या नाष्ट्रा अतितार्याः ।
मुञ्चन्तु तस्मात् त्वां देवा अग्नेर्वैश्वानरा दधि॥
verses.tr: ye mṛtyava ekaśataṃ yā nāṣṭrā atitāryāḥ muñcantu tasmāt tvāṃ devā agnervaiśvānarā dadhi
verses.en: One and a hundred modes of death, dangers that may be overcome,—May Gods deliver thee from this when Agni, dear to all men, bids.

verses.sa:
अग्नेः शरीरमसि पारयिष्णु रक्षोहासि सपत्नहा।
अथो अमीवचातनः पूतुद्रुर्नाम भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: agneḥ śarīramasi pārayiṣṇu rakṣohāsi sapatnahā atho amīvacātanaḥ pūtudrurnāma bheṣajam
verses.en: Body of Agni prompt to save, slayer of fiends and foes art thou, Yea, banisher of malady, the healing balm called Sutudri.

sections.label: A prayer for the destruction of demons
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 3

verses.sa:
रक्षोहणं वाजिनमा जिघर्मि मित्रं प्रथिष्ठमुप यामि शर्म ।
शिशानो अग्निः क्रतुभिः समिद्धः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम्॥
verses.tr: rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinamā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭhamupa yāmi śarma śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam
verses.en: I Balm with oil the mighty demon-slayer, to the most famous friend I come for shelter. Enkindled, sharpened by our rites, may Agni protect us in the day and night from evil.

verses.sa:
अयोदंष्ट्रो अर्चिषा यातुधानानुप स्पृश जातवेदः समिद्धः ।
आ जिह्वया मूरदेवान् रभस्व क्रव्यादो वृष्ट्वापि धत्स्वासन्॥
verses.tr: ayodaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānānupa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ ā jihvayā mūradevān rabhasva kravyādo vṛṣṭvāpi dhatsvāsan
verses.en: O Jatavedas, armed with teeth of iron, enkindled with thy flame, attack the demons. Seize with thy tongue the foolish gods' adorers: rend, put within thy mouth the raw-flesh-eaters.

verses.sa:
उभोभयाविन्नुप धेहि दंष्ट्रौ हिंस्रः शिशानोऽवरं परं च ।
उतान्तरिक्षे परि याह्यग्ने जम्भैः सं धेह्यभि यातुधानान्॥
verses.tr: ubhobhayāvinnupa dhehi daṃṣṭrau hiṃsraḥ śiśāno'varaṃ paraṃ ca utāntarikṣe pari yāhyagne jambhaiḥ saṃ dhehyabhi yātudhānān
verses.en: Apply thy teeth, the upper and the lower, thou who hast both, enkindled and destroying. Roam also in the air, O King, around us, and with thy jaws assail the wicked spirits.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वचं यातुधानस्य भिन्धि हिंस्राशनिर्हरसा हन्त्वेनम्।
प्र पर्वाणि जातवेदः शृणीहि क्रव्यात् क्रविष्णुर्वि चिनोत्वेनम्॥
verses.tr: agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhindhi hiṃsrāśanirharasā hantvenam pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyāt kraviṣṇurvi cinotvenam
verses.en: Pierce through the Yatudhana's skin, O Agni; let the destroying dart with fire consume him. Rend his joints, Jatavedas! let the eater of raw flesh, seeking flesh, tear and destroy him.

verses.sa:
यत्रेदानीं पश्यसि जातवेदस्तिष्ठन्तमग्न उत वा चरन्तम्।
उतान्तरिक्षे पतन्तं यातुधानं तमस्ता विध्य शर्वा शिशानः॥
verses.tr: yatredānīṃ paśyasi jātavedastiṣṭhantamagna uta vā carantam utāntarikṣe patantaṃ yātudhānaṃ tamastā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ
verses.en: Where now thou seest, Agni Jatavedas! a Yatudhana, standing still or roaming, Or one that flieth through the air's mid-region, kindled to fury as an archer pierce him.

verses.sa:
यज्ञरिषूः संनममानो अग्ने वाचा शल्याँ अशनिभिर्दिहानः ।
ताभिर्विध्य हृदये यातुधानान् प्रतीचो बाहून् प्रति भङ्ग्ध्येषाम्॥
verses.tr: yajñariṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyāṃ aśanibhirdihānaḥ tābhirvidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān pratīco bāhūn prati bhaṅgdhyeṣām
verses.en: Bending thy shafts through sacrifices, Agni! dipping thine arrows in the hymn to point them, Pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas, and break their arms uplifted to attack thee.

verses.sa:
उतारब्धान्त्स्पृनुहि जातवेद उतारेभाणाँ ऋष्टिभिर्यातुधानान्।
अग्ने पूर्वो नि जहि शोशुचान आमादः क्ष्विङ्कास्तमदन्त्वेनीः॥
verses.tr: utārabdhāntspṛnuhi jātaveda utārebhāṇāṃ ṛṣṭibhiryātudhānān agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkāstamadantvenīḥ
verses.en: Rescue the captive? also, Jatavedas! yea, those whom Yatudhanas' spears have captured. Strike down that fiend, blazing before him, Agni! Let spotted carrion-eating kites devour him.

verses.sa:
इह प्र ब्रूहि यतमः सो अग्ने यातुधानो य इदं कृणोति ।
तमा रभस्व समिधा यविष्ठ नृचक्षसश्चक्षुषे रन्धयैनम्॥
verses.tr: iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yātudhāno ya idaṃ kṛṇoti tamā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaścakṣuṣe randhayainam
verses.en: Here tell this forth, O Agni: whosoever is, he himself, or acteth as, a demon, Grasp him, O thou most youthful, with thy fuel: to the Man-seer's eye give him as booty.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णेनाग्ने चक्षुषा रक्ष यज्ञं प्राञ्चं वसुभ्यः प्र णय प्रचेतः ।
हिंस्रं रक्षांस्यभि शोशुचानं मा त्वा दभन् यातुधाना नृचक्षः॥
verses.tr: tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsyabhi śośucānaṃ mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ
verses.en: With keen glance guard the sacrifice, O Agni: thou Sage, conduct it onward to the Vasus. Let not the fiends, O Man-beholder, harm thee burning against the Rakshasas to slay them.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षा रक्षः परि पश्य विक्षु तस्य त्रीणि प्रति शृणीह्यग्रा ।
तस्याग्ने पृष्टीर्हरसा शृणीहि त्रेधा मूलं यातुधानस्य वृश्च॥
verses.tr: nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhyagrā tasyāgne pṛṣṭīrharasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca
verses.en: Look on the fiend, 'mid men, as Man-beholder: rend thou his three extremities in pieces. Demolish with thy flame his ribs, O Agni: the Yatudhana's root destroy thou triply.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्यातुधानः प्रसितिं त एत्वृतं यो अग्ने अनृतेन हन्ति ।
तमर्चिषा स्फूर्जयन् जातवेदः समक्षमेनं गृणते नि युङ्ग्धि॥
verses.tr: triryātudhānaḥ prasitiṃ ta etvṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti tamarciṣā sphūrjayan jātavedaḥ samakṣamenaṃ gṛṇate ni yuṅgdhi
verses.en: Thrice, Agni, let thy noose surround the demon who with his falsehood injures holy Order. Loud roaring with thy flame, O Jatavedas, fetter him in the presence of the singer.

verses.sa:
यदग्ने अद्य मिथुना शपातो यद् वाचस्तृष्टं जनयन्त रेभाः ।
मन्योर्मनसः शरव्या३जायते या तया विध्य हृदये यातुधानान्॥
verses.tr: yadagne adya mithunā śapāto yad vācastṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ manyormanasaḥ śaravyā3jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān
verses.en: Agni, what curse the pair this day may utter, what rude rough word the worshippers have spoken, Each arrowy taunt sped from the angry spirit,—pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas.

verses.sa:
परा शृणीहि तपसा यातुधानान् पराग्ने रक्षो हरसा शृणीहि ।
परार्चिषा मूरदेवान्छृणीहि परासुतृपः शोशुचतः शृणीहि॥
verses.tr: parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānān parāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi parārciṣā mūradevānchṛṇīhi parāsutṛpaḥ śośucataḥ śṛṇīhi
verses.en: With fervent heat exterminate the demons: destroy the fiends with glow and flame, O Agni. Destroy with fire the foolish gods' adorers: destroy the insatiate fiercely-burning creatures.

verses.sa:
पराद्य देवा वृजिनं शृणन्तु प्रत्यगेनं शपथा यन्तु सृष्टाः ।
वाचास्तेनं शरव ऋच्छन्तु मर्मन् विश्वस्यैतु प्रसितिं यातुधानः॥
verses.tr: parādya devā vṛjinaṃ śṛṇantu pratyagenaṃ śapathā yantu sṛṣṭāḥ vācāstenaṃ śarava ṛcchantu marman viśvasyaitu prasitiṃ yātudhānaḥ
verses.en: May Gods destroy to-day the evil-doer: may uttered curses turn again and strike him. Let arrows pierce the liar in his vitals, and Visva's net enclose the Yatudhana.

verses.sa:
यः पौरुषेयेण क्रविषा समङ्क्ते यो अश्व्येन पशुना यातुधानः ।
यो अघ्न्याया भरति क्षीरमग्ने तेषां शीर्षाणि हरसापि वृश्च॥
verses.tr: yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhānaḥ yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīramagne teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca
verses.en: The fiend who smears himself with flesh of cattle, with flesh of horses and of human bodies, Who steals the milch-cow's milk away, O Agni,—tear off the heads of such with fiery fury.

verses.sa:
विषं गवां यातुधाना भरन्तामा वृश्चन्तामदितये दुरेवाः ।
परैणान् देवः सविता ददातु परा भागमोषधीनां जयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānā bharantāmā vṛścantāmaditaye durevāḥ paraiṇān devaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgamoṣadhīnāṃ jayantām
verses.en: Let the fiends steal the poison of the cattle: may Aditi cast off the evil-doers. May the God Savitar give them up to ruin, and be their share of herbs and plants denied them.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरीणं पय उस्रियायास्तस्य माशीद् यातुधानो नृचक्षः ।
पीयूषमग्ने यतमस्तितृप्सात् तं प्रत्यञ्चमर्चिषा विध्य मर्मणि॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsarīṇaṃ paya usriyāyāstasya māśīd yātudhāno nṛcakṣaḥ pīyūṣamagne yatamastitṛpsāt taṃ pratyañcamarciṣā vidhya marmaṇi
verses.en: The cow gives milk each year, O Man-beholder: let not the Yatudhana ever taste it. Agni, if one should glut him with the biestings, pierce with thy flame his vitals as he meets thee.

verses.sa:
सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान् न त्वा रक्षांसि पृतनासु जिग्युः ।
सहमूराननु दह क्रव्यादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः॥
verses.tr: sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānān na tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ sahamūrānanu daha kravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ
verses.en: Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never have Rakshasas in fight overcome thee. Burn up the foolish ones, the flesh-devourers: let none of them escape thy heavenly arrow.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अधरादुदक्तस्त्वं पश्चादुत रक्षा पुरस्तात्।
प्रति त्ये ते अजरासस्तपिष्ठा अघशंसं शोशुचतो दहन्तु॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne adharādudaktastvaṃ paścāduta rakṣā purastāt prati tye te ajarāsastapiṣṭhā aghaśaṃsaṃ śośucato dahantu
verses.en: Guard us, O Agni, from above and under, protect us from behind and from before us; And may thy flames, most fierce and never wasting, glowing with fervent heat, consume the sinner.

verses.sa:
पश्चात् पुरस्तादधरादुतोत्तरात् कविः काव्येन परि पाह्यग्ने ।
सखा सखायमजरो जरिम्णे अग्ने मर्ताँ अमर्त्यस्त्वं नः॥
verses.tr: paścāt purastādadharādutottarāt kaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhyagne sakhā sakhāyamajaro jarimṇe agne martāṃ amartyastvaṃ naḥ
verses.en: From rear, from front, from under, from above us, Agni, protect us as a sage with wisdom. Guard to old age thy friend as friend eternal: O Agni, as immortal, guard us mortals.

verses.sa:
तदग्ने चक्षुः प्रति धेहि रेभे शफारुजो येन पश्यसि यातुधानान्।
अथर्ववज्ज्योतिषा दैव्येन सत्यं धूर्वन्तमचितं न्योऽष॥
verses.tr: tadagne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śaphārujo yena paśyasi yātudhānān atharvavajjyotiṣā daivyena satyaṃ dhūrvantamacitaṃ nyo'ṣa
verses.en: Lend thou the worshipper that eye, O Agni, wherewith thou lookest on the hoof-armed demons. With light celestial in Atharvan's manner burn up the fool who ruins truth with falsehood.

verses.sa:
परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रं सहस्य धीमहि ।
धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावतः॥
verses.tr: pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ divedive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvataḥ
verses.en: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni! thee, a sage, In conquering colour day by day, destroyer of the treacherous foe.

verses.sa:
विषेण भङ्गुरावतः प्रति स्म रक्षसो जहि ।
अग्ने तिग्मेन शोचिषा तपुरग्राभिरर्चिभिः॥
verses.tr: viṣeṇa bhaṅgurāvataḥ prati sma rakṣaso jahi agne tigmena śociṣā tapuragrābhirarcibhiḥ
verses.en: With deadly poison strike thou back the treacherous brood of Rakshasas, O Agni, with thy sharpened. glow, with rays that flash with points of flame.

verses.sa:
वि ज्योतिषा बृहता भात्यग्निराविर्विश्वानि कृणुते महित्वा।
प्रादेवीर्मायाः सहते दुरेवाः शिशीते शृङ्गे रक्षोभ्यो विनिक्ष्वे॥
verses.tr: vi jyotiṣā bṛhatā bhātyagnirāvirviśvāni kṛṇute mahitvā prādevīrmāyāḥ sahate durevāḥ śiśīte śṛṅge rakṣobhyo vinikṣve
verses.en: Agni shines far and wide with lofty splendour, and by his greatness makes all things apparent. He conquers godless and malign enchantments, and sharpens both his horns to gore the ogres.

verses.sa:
ये ते शृङ्गे अजरे जातवेदस्तिग्महेती ब्रह्मसंशिते ।
ताभ्यां दुर्हार्दमभिदासन्तं किमीदिनं प्रत्यञ्चमर्चिषा जातवेदो वि निक्ष्व॥
verses.tr: ye te śṛṅge ajare jātavedastigmahetī brahmasaṃśite tābhyāṃ durhārdamabhidāsantaṃ kimīdinaṃ pratyañcamarciṣā jātavedo vi nikṣva
verses.en: Thy two unwasting horns, O Jatavedas, keen-pointed weapons, sharpened by devotion—With these transfix the wicked-souled Kimidin, with fierce flame, Jatavedas! when he meets thee.

verses.sa:
अग्नी रक्षांसि सेधति शुक्रशोचिरमर्त्यः ।
शुचिः पावक ईड्यः॥
verses.tr: agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati śukraśociramartyaḥ śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyaḥ
verses.en: Bright, radiant, meet to be adored, immortal with refulgent glow, Agni drives Rakshasas away.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा तपतं रक्ष उब्जतं न्यऽर्पयतं वृषणा तमोवृधः ।
परा शृणीतमचितो न्योऽषतं हतं नुदेथां नि शिशीतमत्त्रिणः॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā tapataṃ rakṣa ubjataṃ nya'rpayataṃ vṛṣaṇā tamovṛdhaḥ parā śṛṇītamacito nyo'ṣataṃ hataṃ nudethāṃ ni śiśītamattriṇaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Soma, burn, destroy the demon foe! Send downward, O ye Bulls, those who add gloom to gloom. Annihilate the fools, slay them and burn them up: chase them away from us, pierce the voracious fiends.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा समघशंसमभ्य१घं तपुर्ययस्तु चरुरग्निमाँ इव ।
ब्रह्मद्विषे क्रव्यादे घोरचक्षसे द्वेषो धत्तमनवायं किमीदिने॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā samaghaśaṃsamabhya1ghaṃ tapuryayastu caruragnimāṃ iva brahmadviṣe kravyāde ghoracakṣase dveṣo dhattamanavāyaṃ kimīdine
verses.en: Let sin, Indra and Soma! round the wicked boil, like as a caldron set amid the flames of fire. Against the foe of prayer, eater of gory flesh, the fearful-eyed Kimidin, keep perpetual hate.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृतो वव्रे अन्तरनारम्भणे तमसि प्र विध्यतम्।
यतो नैषां पुनरेकश्चनोदयत् तद् वामस्तु सहसे मन्युमच्छवः॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā duṣkṛto vavre antaranārambhaṇe tamasi pra vidhyatam yato naiṣāṃ punarekaścanodayat tad vāmastu sahase manyumacchavaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Soma, plunge the wicked in the depth, yea, cast them into darkness that hath no support, So that not one of them may ever thence return: so may your wrathful might prevail and conquer them.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवो वधं सं पृथिव्या अघशंसाय तर्हणम्।
उत् तक्षतं स्वर्यं१ पर्वतेभ्यो येन रक्षो वावृधानं निजूर्वथः॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divo vadhaṃ saṃ pṛthivyā aghaśaṃsāya tarhaṇam ut takṣataṃ svaryaṃ1 parvatebhyo yena rakṣo vāvṛdhānaṃ nijūrvathaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Soma, hurl your deadly crushing bolt down on the wicked fiend from heaven and from the earth. Yea, fashion from the big clouds your celestial dart wherewith ye burn to death the waxing demon race.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवस्पर्यग्नितप्तेभिर्युवमश्महन्मभिः ।
तपुर्वधेभिरजरेभिरत्त्रिणो नि पर्शाने विध्यतं यन्तु निस्वरम्॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divasparyagnitaptebhiryuvamaśmahanmabhiḥ tapurvadhebhirajarebhirattriṇo ni parśāne vidhyataṃ yantu nisvaram
verses.en: Indra and Soma, cast ye downward from the sky your deadly bolts of stone burning with fiery flame, Eternal, scorching darts. Plunge the voracious fiends within the depth, and let them pass without a sound.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा परि वां भूतु विश्वत इयं मतिः कक्ष्याश्वेव वाजिना ।
यां वां होत्रां परिहिनोमि मेधयेमा ब्रह्माणि नृपती इव जिन्वतम्॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā pari vāṃ bhūtu viśvata iyaṃ matiḥ kakṣyāśveva vājinā yāṃ vāṃ hotrāṃ parihinomi medhayemā brahmāṇi nṛpatī iva jinvatam
verses.en: Indra and Soma, let this hymn control you both, even as the girth encompasses two vigorous steeds—The song of praise which I with wisdom offer you. Do ye, as Lords of men, animate these my prayers.

verses.sa:
प्रति स्मरेथां तुजयद्भिरेवैर्हतं द्रुहो रक्षसो भङ्गुरावतः ।
इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृते मा सुगं भूद् यो मा कदा चिदभिदासति द्रुहुः॥
verses.tr: prati smarethāṃ tujayadbhirevairhataṃ druho rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ indrāsomā duṣkṛte mā sugaṃ bhūd yo mā kadā cidabhidāsati druhuḥ
verses.en: In your impetuous manner think ye both thereon: destroy those evil spirits, kill the treacherous fiends. Indra and Soma, let the wicked have no bliss whoso at any time attacks and injures us.

verses.sa:
यो मा पाकेन मनसा चरन्तमभिचष्टे अनृतेभिर्वचोभिः ।
आप इव काशिना संगृभीता असन्नस्त्वसतः इन्द्र वक्ता॥
verses.tr: yo mā pākena manasā carantamabhicaṣṭe anṛtebhirvacobhiḥ āpa iva kāśinā saṃgṛbhītā asannastvasataḥ indra vaktā
verses.en: Whoso accuses me with words of falsehood when I pursue my way with guileless spirit, May he, the speaker of untruth, be, Indra! f like water which the hollowed hand compresses.

verses.sa:
ये पाकशंसं विहरन्त एवैर्ये वा भद्रं दूषयन्ति स्वधाभिः ।
अहये वा तान् प्रददातु सोम आ वा दधातु निरृतेरुपस्थे॥
verses.tr: ye pākaśaṃsaṃ viharanta evairye vā bhadraṃ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ ahaye vā tān pradadātu soma ā vā dadhātu nirṛterupasthe
verses.en: Those who destroy, as is their wont, the simple, and with their evil natures harm the righteous, May Soma give them over to the serpent, or to the lap of Nirriti consign them.

verses.sa:
यो नो रसं दिप्सति पित्वो अग्ने अश्वानां गवां यस्तनूनाम्।
रिपु स्तेन स्तेयकृद् दभ्रमेतु नि ष हीयतां तन्वा३ तना च॥
verses.tr: yo no rasaṃ dipsati pitvo agne aśvānāṃ gavāṃ yastanūnām ripu stena steyakṛd dabhrametu ni ṣa hīyatāṃ tanvā3 tanā ca
verses.en: O Agni, whosoever seeks to injure the essence of our food, kine, steeds, or bodies, May he, the adversary, thief, and robber, sink to destruction, both himself and offspring.

verses.sa:
परः सो अस्तु तन्वा३ तना च तिस्रः पृथिवीरधो अस्तु विश्वाः ।
प्रति शुष्यतु यशो अस्य देवा यो मा दिवा दिप्सति यश्च नक्तम्॥
verses.tr: paraḥ so astu tanvā3 tanā ca tisraḥ pṛthivīradho astu viśvāḥ prati śuṣyatu yaśo asya devā yo mā divā dipsati yaśca naktam
verses.en: May he be swept away, himself and children; may all the three earths press him down beneath them. May his fair glory, O ye Gods, be blighted, who in the day or night would fain destroy us.

verses.sa:
सुविज्ञानं चिकितुषे जनाय सच्चासच्च वचसी पस्पृधाते ।
तयोर्यत् सत्यं यतरदृजीयस्तदित् सोमोऽवति हन्त्यसत्॥
verses.tr: suvijñānaṃ cikituṣe janāya saccāsacca vacasī paspṛdhāte tayoryat satyaṃ yataradṛjīyastadit somo'vati hantyasat
verses.en: The prudent finds it easy to distinguish the true and false: their words oppose each other. Of these two that which is the true and honest Soma protects, and brings the false to nothing.

verses.sa:
न वा उ सोमो वृजिनं हिनोति न क्षत्रियं मिथुया धारयन्तम्।
हन्ति रक्षो हन्त्यासद् वदन्तमुभाविन्द्रस्य प्रसितौ शयाते॥
verses.tr: na vā u somo vṛjinaṃ hinoti na kṣatriyaṃ mithuyā dhārayantam hanti rakṣo hantyāsad vadantamubhāvindrasya prasitau śayāte
verses.en: Never doth Soma aid and guide the wicked or him who falsely claims the Warrior's title. He slays the fiend and him who speaks untruly: both lie entangled in the noose of Indra.

verses.sa:
यदि वाहमनृतदेवो अस्मि मोघं वा देवाँ अप्यूहे अग्ने ।
किमस्मभ्यं जातवेदो हृणीषे द्रोघवाचस्ते निरृथं सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: yadi vāhamanṛtadevo asmi moghaṃ vā devāṃ apyūhe agne kimasmabhyaṃ jātavedo hṛṇīṣe droghavācaste nirṛthaṃ sacantām
verses.en: As if I worshipped deities of falsehood, or thought vain thoughts about the Gods, O Agni! Why art thou angry with us, Jatavedas? Destruction fall on those who lie against thee!

verses.sa:
अद्या मुरीय यदि यातुधानो अस्मि यदि वायुस्ततप पुरुषस्य ।
अधा स वीरैर्दशभिर्वि यूया यो मा मोघं यातुधानेत्याह॥
verses.tr: adyā murīya yadi yātudhāno asmi yadi vāyustatapa puruṣasya adhā sa vīrairdaśabhirvi yūyā yo mā moghaṃ yātudhānetyāha
verses.en: So may I die this day if I have harassed any man's life, or if I be a demon. Yea, may he lose all his ten sons together who with false tongue hath called me Yatudhana.

verses.sa:
यो मायातुं यातुधानेत्याह यो वा रक्षाः शुचिरस्मीत्याह ।
इन्द्रस्तं हन्तु महता वधेन विश्वस्य जन्तोरधमस्पदीष्ट॥
verses.tr: yo māyātuṃ yātudhānetyāha yo vā rakṣāḥ śucirasmītyāha indrastaṃ hantu mahatā vadhena viśvasya jantoradhamaspadīṣṭa
verses.en: May Indra slay him with a mighty weapon, and let the vilest of all creatures perish, The fiend who says that he is pure, who calls me a demon though devoid of demon nature.

verses.sa:
प्र या जिगाति खर्गलेव नक्तमप द्रुहुस्तन्वं१गूहमाना ।
वव्रमनन्तमव सा पदीष्ट ग्रावाणो घ्नन्तु रक्षस उपब्दैः॥
verses.tr: pra yā jigāti khargaleva naktamapa druhustanvaṃ1gūhamānā vavramanantamava sā padīṣṭa grāvāṇo ghnantu rakṣasa upabdaiḥ
verses.en: She too who wanders like an owl at night-time, hiding her body in her guile and malice, May she fall downward into endless caverns. May press-stones with loud ring destroy the demons.

verses.sa:
वि तिष्ठध्वं मरुतो विक्ष्वि३छत गृभायत रक्षसः सं पिनष्टन।
वयो ये भूत्वा पतयन्ति नक्तभिर्ये वा रिपो दधिरे देवे अध्वरे॥
verses.tr: vi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ maruto vikṣvi3chata gṛbhāyata rakṣasaḥ saṃ pinaṣṭana vayo ye bhūtvā patayanti naktabhirye vā ripo dadhire deve adhvare
verses.en: Spread out, ye Maruts, search among the people: seize ye and grind the Rakshasas to pieces, Who fly abroad, transformed to birds, at night-time, and sully and pollute our holy worship.

verses.sa:
प्र वर्तय दिवोऽश्मानमिन्द्र सोमशितं मघवन्त्सं शिशाधि ।
प्राक्तो अपाक्तोअधरादुदक्तोऽभिजहि रक्षसः पर्वतेन॥
verses.tr: pra vartaya divo'śmānamindra somaśitaṃ maghavantsaṃ śiśādhi prākto apāktoadharādudakto'bhijahi rakṣasaḥ parvatena
verses.en: Hurl down from heaven thy bolt of stone, O Indra: sharpen it, Maghavan, made keen by Soma. Forward, behind, and from above and under, smite down the demons with thy rocky weapon.

verses.sa:
एत उ त्ये पतयन्ति श्वयातव इन्द्रं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवोऽदाभ्यम्।
शिशीते शक्रः पिशुनेभ्यो वधं नुनं सृजदशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: eta u tye patayanti śvayātava indraṃ dipsanti dipsavo'dābhyam śiśīte śakraḥ piśunebhyo vadhaṃ nunaṃ sṛjadaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ
verses.en: They fly, the demon dogs, and, bent on mischief, fain would they harm indomitable Indra. Sakra makes sharp his weapon for the wicked: now let him cast his bolt at fiendish wizards.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यातूनामभवत् पराशरो हविर्मथीनामभ्या३विवासताम्।
अभीदु शक्रः परशुर्यथा वनं पात्रेव भिन्दन्त्सत एतु रक्षसः॥
verses.tr: indro yātūnāmabhavat parāśaro havirmathīnāmabhyā3vivāsatām abhīdu śakraḥ paraśuryathā vanaṃ pātreva bhindantsata etu rakṣasaḥ
verses.en: Indra hath ever been the fiends' destroyer who spoil oblations of the Gods' invokers. Yea, Sakra, like an axe that splits the timber, assails and smashes them like earthen vessels.

verses.sa:
उलूकयातुं शुशुलूकयातुं जहि श्वयातुमुत कोकयातुम्।
सुपर्णयातुमुत गृध्रयातुं दृषदेव प्र मृण रक्ष इन्द्र॥
verses.tr: ulūkayātuṃ śuśulūkayātuṃ jahi śvayātumuta kokayātum suparṇayātumuta gṛdhrayātuṃ dṛṣadeva pra mṛṇa rakṣa indra
verses.en: Destroy the fiend shaped like an owl or owlet, destroy him in the form of dog or cuckoo. Destroy him shaped as eagle or as vulture: as with a stone, O Indra, crush the demon.

verses.sa:
मा नो रक्षो अभि नड् यातुमावदपोच्छन्तु मिथुना ये किमीदिनः ।
पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात् पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात् पात्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: mā no rakṣo abhi naḍ yātumāvadapocchantu mithunā ye kimīdinaḥ pṛthivī naḥ pārthivāt pātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyāt pātvasmān
verses.en: Let not the fiend of witchcraft-workers reach us. may Dawn drive off the couples of Kimidins. Earth keep us safe from earthly woe and trouble! From grief that comes from heaven Mid-air preserve us!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जहि पुमांसं यातुधानमुत स्त्रियं मायया शाशदानाम्।
विग्रीवासो मूरदेवा ऋदन्तु मा ते दृशन्त्सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम्॥
verses.tr: indra jahi pumāṃsaṃ yātudhānamuta striyaṃ māyayā śāśadānām vigrīvāso mūradevā ṛdantu mā te dṛśantsūryamuccarantam
verses.en: Indra destroy the demon, male and female, joying and triumphing in arts of magic! Let the fools gods with bent necks fall and perish, and see no more the Sun when he arises.

verses.sa:
प्रति चक्ष्व वि चक्ष्वेन्द्रश्च सोम जागृतम्।
रक्षोभ्यो वधमस्यतमशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: prati cakṣva vi cakṣvendraśca soma jāgṛtam rakṣobhyo vadhamasyatamaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ
verses.en: Look, each one, hither, look around. Indra and Soma, watch ye well. Cast forth your weapon at the fiends: against the sorcerers hurl your bolt.

sections.label: A charm accompanying investiture with an amulet
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 5

verses.sa:
अयं प्रतिसरो मणिर्वीरो वीराय बध्यते ।
वीर्यऽवान्त्सपत्नहा शूरवीरः परिपाणः सुमङ्गलः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ pratisaro maṇirvīro vīrāya badhyate vīrya'vāntsapatnahā śūravīraḥ paripāṇaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ
verses.en: Upon the strong is bound the strong, this magic cord, this Amulet, Potent, foe-slayer, served by valiant heroes, happy and fortunate defence.

verses.sa:
अयं मणिः सपत्नहा सुवीरः सहस्वान् वाजी सहमान उग्रः ।
प्रत्यक् कृत्या दूषयन्नेति वीरः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ maṇiḥ sapatnahā suvīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamāna ugraḥ pratyak kṛtyā dūṣayanneti vīraḥ
verses.en: This Charm, foe-slayer, served by many heroes, strong, powerful, victorious, and mighty, goes Since forth to meet and ruin witchcraft.

verses.sa:
अनेनेन्द्रो मणिना वृत्रमहन्ननेनासुरान् पराभावयन्मनीषी।
अनेनाजयद् द्यावापृथिवी उभे इमे अनेनाजयत् प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: anenendro maṇinā vṛtramahannanenāsurān parābhāvayanmanīṣī anenājayad dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime anenājayat pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: With this same Amulet wise Indra routed the Asuras, with this he slaughtered Vritra, With this he won this pair, both Earth and Heaven, and made the sky's four regions his possession.

verses.sa:
अयं स्राक्त्यो मणिः प्रतीवर्तः प्रतिसरः ।
ओजस्वान् विमृधो वशी सो अस्मान् पातु सर्वतः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ srāktyo maṇiḥ pratīvartaḥ pratisaraḥ ojasvān vimṛdho vaśī so asmān pātu sarvataḥ
verses.en: May this encircling magic cord, this Amulet of Sraktya wood, Mighty, subduing enemies, keep us secure on every side.

verses.sa:
तदग्निराह तदु सोम आह बृहस्पतिः सविता तदिन्द्रः ।
ते मे देवाः पुरोहिताः प्रतीचीः कृत्याः प्रतिसरैरजन्तु॥
verses.tr: tadagnirāha tadu soma āha bṛhaspatiḥ savitā tadindraḥ te me devāḥ purohitāḥ pratīcīḥ kṛtyāḥ pratisarairajantu
verses.en: This Agni hath declared, Soma declared it, Brihaspati, and Savitar, and Indra. So may these Gods whom I have set before me oppose with saving charms and banish witchcraft.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्दधे द्यावापृथिवी उताहरुत सूर्यम्।
ते मे देवाः पुरोहिताः प्रतीचीः कृत्याः प्रतिसरैरजन्तु॥
verses.tr: antardadhe dyāvāpṛthivī utāharuta sūryam te me devāḥ purohitāḥ pratīcīḥ kṛtyāḥ pratisarairajantu
verses.en: I have obscured the heaven and earth, yea, and the daylight and the sun. So may the-e Gods whom I have set before me °Pp$s w saving charms and banish witchcraft,

verses.sa:
ये स्राक्त्यं मणिं जना वर्माणि कृण्वते ।
सूर्य इव दिवमारुह्य वि कृत्या बाधते वशी॥
verses.tr: ye srāktyaṃ maṇiṃ janā varmāṇi kṛṇvate sūrya iva divamāruhya vi kṛtyā bādhate vaśī
verses.en: Whoever for his armour takes an amulet of the Sraktya tree, Like the Sun risen up to heaven, quells witchcraft with superior might.

verses.sa:
स्राक्त्येन मणिन ऋषिणेव मनीषिणा ।
अजैषं सर्वाः पृतना वि मृधो हन्मि रक्षसः॥
verses.tr: srāktyena maṇina ṛṣiṇeva manīṣiṇā ajaiṣaṃ sarvāḥ pṛtanā vi mṛdho hanmi rakṣasaḥ
verses.en: With Amulet of Sraktya wood, as with a thoughtful Rishi's aid, In every fight have I prevailed; I smite the foes and Rakshasas.

verses.sa:
याः कृत्या आङ्गिरसीर्याः कृत्या आसुरीर्याः ।
कृत्याः स्वयंकृता या उ चान्येभिराभृताः ।
उभयीस्ताः परा यन्तु परावतो नवतिं नाव्या३अति॥
verses.tr: yāḥ kṛtyā āṅgirasīryāḥ kṛtyā āsurīryāḥ kṛtyāḥ svayaṃkṛtā yā u cānyebhirābhṛtāḥ ubhayīstāḥ parā yantu parāvato navatiṃ nāvyā3ati
verses.en: All witchcraft of Angirases, all witchcraft wrought by Asuras, All witchcraft self-originate, and all that others have prepared, May these depart to both remotest spaces, past ninety ample water-floods.

verses.sa:
अस्मै मणिं वर्म बध्नन्तु देवा इन्द्रो विष्णुः सविता रुद्रो अग्निः ।
प्रजापतिः परमेष्ठी विराड् वैश्वानर ऋषयश्च सर्वे॥
verses.tr: asmai maṇiṃ varma badhnantu devā indro viṣṇuḥ savitā rudro agniḥ prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhī virāḍ vaiśvānara ṛṣayaśca sarve
verses.en: May the Gods bind the Charm on him for armour, Indra, and Vishnu, Savitar, Rudra, Agni, Prajapati, sublimest Parameshthin, Viraj, Vaisvanara, and all the Rishis.

verses.sa:
उत्तमो अस्योषधीनामनड्वान् जगतामिव व्याघ्रः श्वपदामिव ।
यमैच्छामाविदाम तं प्रतिस्पाशनमन्तितम्॥
verses.tr: uttamo asyoṣadhīnāmanaḍvān jagatāmiva vyāghraḥ śvapadāmiva yamaicchāmāvidāma taṃ pratispāśanamantitam
verses.en: Thou art the chief of all the plants, even as a bull among the beasts, A tiger of the beasts of prey. Him whom we sought for have we found, him lying near in wait for us.

verses.sa:
स इद् व्याघ्रो भवत्यथो सिंहो अथो वृषा ।
अथो सपत्नकर्शनो यो बिभर्तीमं मणिम्॥
verses.tr: sa id vyāghro bhavatyatho siṃho atho vṛṣā atho sapatnakarśano yo bibhartīmaṃ maṇim
verses.en: A tiger verily is he, he is a lion, and a bull, Subduer of his foes is he, the man who wears this Amulet.

verses.sa:
नैनं घ्नन्त्यप्सरसो न गन्धर्वा न मर्त्याः ।
सर्वा दिशो वि राजति यो बिभर्तीमं मणिम्॥
verses.tr: nainaṃ ghnantyapsaraso na gandharvā na martyāḥ sarvā diśo vi rājati yo bibhartīmaṃ maṇim
verses.en: No mortal beings slay him, no Gandharvas, no Apsarases; O'er all the regions he is king, the man who wears this Amulet.

verses.sa:
कश्यपस्त्वामसृजत कश्यपस्त्वा समैरयत्।
अबिभस्त्वेन्द्रो मानुषे बिभ्रत् संश्रेषिणेऽजयत्।
मणिं सहस्रवीर्यं वर्म देवा अकृण्वत॥
verses.tr: kaśyapastvāmasṛjata kaśyapastvā samairayat abibhastvendro mānuṣe bibhrat saṃśreṣiṇe'jayat maṇiṃ sahasravīryaṃ varma devā akṛṇvata
verses.en: Kasyapa formed and fashioned thee, Kasyapa raised and sent thee forth. Indra wore thee, and, wearing thee, won in the wrestling-match with man. The Amulet of boundless might the Gods have made a coat of mail.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा कृत्याभिर्यस्त्वा दीक्षाभिर्यज्ञैर्यस्त्वा जिघांसति ।
प्रत्यक् त्वमिन्द्र तं जहि वज्रेण शतपर्वणा॥
verses.tr: yastvā kṛtyābhiryastvā dīkṣābhiryajñairyastvā jighāṃsati pratyak tvamindra taṃ jahi vajreṇa śataparvaṇā
verses.en: Whoever would destroy thee with Diksha-rites, sacrifices, spells, Meet him and smite him, Indra! with thy hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
अयमिद् वै प्रतीवर्त ओजस्वान् संजयो मणिः ।
प्रजां धनं च रक्षतु परिपाणः सुमङ्गलः॥
verses.tr: ayamid vai pratīvarta ojasvān saṃjayo maṇiḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ ca rakṣatu paripāṇaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ
verses.en: Verily let this Amulet, circular, potent, conquering, Happy and fortunate defence, preserve thy children and thy wealth.

verses.sa:
असपत्नं नो अधरादसपत्नं न उत्तरात्।
इन्द्रासपत्नं नः पश्चाज्ज्योतिः शूर पुरस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: asapatnaṃ no adharādasapatnaṃ na uttarāt indrāsapatnaṃ naḥ paścājjyotiḥ śūra puraskṛdhi
verses.en: Brave Indra, set before us light, peace and security from below, Peace and security from above, peace and security from behind.

verses.sa:
वर्म मे द्यावापृथिवी वर्माहर्वर्म सूर्यः ।
वर्म म इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च वर्म धाता दधातु मे॥
verses.tr: varma me dyāvāpṛthivī varmāharvarma sūryaḥ varma ma indraścāgniśca varma dhātā dadhātu me
verses.en: My coat of mail is Heaven and Earth, my coat of mail is Day and Sun: A coat of mail may Indra and Agni and Dhatar grant to me.

verses.sa:
ऐन्द्राग्नं वर्म बहुलं यदुग्रं विश्वे देवा नाति विध्यन्ति सर्वे ।
तन्मे तन्वं त्रायतां सर्वतो बृहदायुष्मां जरदष्टिर्यथासानि॥
verses.tr: aindrāgnaṃ varma bahulaṃ yadugraṃ viśve devā nāti vidhyanti sarve tanme tanvaṃ trāyatāṃ sarvato bṛhadāyuṣmāṃ jaradaṣṭiryathāsāni
verses.en: Not all the Gods may pierce, all leagued together, the vast strong shield which Indra gives, and Agni. May that great shield on all sides guard my body, that to full eld my life may be extended.

verses.sa:
आ मारुक्षद् देवमणिर्मह्या अरिष्टतातये ।
इमं मेथिमभिसंविशध्वं तनूपानं त्रिवरूथमोजसे॥
verses.tr: ā mārukṣad devamaṇirmahyā ariṣṭatātaye imaṃ methimabhisaṃviśadhvaṃ tanūpānaṃ trivarūthamojase
verses.en: Let the Gods' Charm be bound on me to keep me safe from every ill. Come ye and enter all within this pillar, the safeguard of the body, thrice-defended.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्निन्द्रो नि दधातु नृम्णमिमं देवासो अभिसंविशध्वम्।
दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदायायुष्मान् जरदष्टिर्यथासत्॥
verses.tr: asminnindro ni dadhātu nṛmṇamimaṃ devāso abhisaṃviśadhvam dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāyāyuṣmān jaradaṣṭiryathāsat
verses.en: In this let Indra lay a store of valour: approach ye Gods, and enter it together, For his long life, to last a hundred autumns, that to full age his days may be extended.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तिदा विशां पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी।
इन्द्रो बध्नातु ते मणिं जिगीवाँ अपराजितः सोमपा अभयङ्करो वृषा ।
स त्वा रक्षतु सर्वतो दिवा नक्तं च विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: svastidā viśāṃ patirvṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī indro badhnātu te maṇiṃ jigīvāṃ aparājitaḥ somapā abhayaṅkaro vṛṣā sa tvā rakṣatu sarvato divā naktaṃ ca viśvataḥ
verses.en: Lord of the clan who brings us bliss, fiend-slayer, queller of the foe, May he, the conqueror, ne'er subdued, may Indra bind the Charm on thee, Bull, Soma-drinker, he who gives us peace. May he protect thee round about, by night and day on every side,

sections.label: A charm to exorcise evil spirits who beset women
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 6

verses.sa:
यौ ते मातोन्ममार्ज जातायाः पतिवेदनौ ।
दुर्णामा तत्र मा गृधदलिंश उत वत्सपः॥
verses.tr: yau te mātonmamārja jātāyāḥ pativedanau durṇāmā tatra mā gṛdhadaliṃśa uta vatsapaḥ
verses.en: Let neither fiend of evil name, Ali sa, Vatsapa, desire Thy pair of husband-wooers which thy mother cleansed when thou wast born.

verses.sa:
पलालानुपलालौ शर्कुं कोकं मलिम्लुचं पलीजकम्।
आश्रेषं वव्रिवाससमृक्षग्रीवं प्रमीलिनम्॥
verses.tr: palālānupalālau śarkuṃ kokaṃ malimlucaṃ palījakam āśreṣaṃ vavrivāsasamṛkṣagrīvaṃ pramīlinam
verses.en: Palala, Anupalala, Sarku, Koka, Malimlucha, Palijaka, Vavrivasas and Asresha, Rikshagriva and Pramilin.

verses.sa:
मा सं वृतो मोप सृप ऊरू माव सृपोऽन्तरा।
कृणोम्यस्यै भेषजं बजं दुर्णामचातनम्॥
verses.tr: mā saṃ vṛto mopa sṛpa ūrū māva sṛpo'ntarā kṛṇomyasyai bheṣajaṃ bajaṃ durṇāmacātanam
verses.en: Approach not, come not hitherward: creep not thou in between her thighs. I set, to guard her, Baja, that which chases him of evil name.

verses.sa:
दुर्णामा च सुनामा चोभा संवृतमिच्छतः ।
अरायानप हन्मः सुनामा स्त्रैणमिच्छताम्॥
verses.tr: durṇāmā ca sunāmā cobhā saṃvṛtamicchataḥ arāyānapa hanmaḥ sunāmā straiṇamicchatām
verses.en: Durnama and Sunama both are eager to converse with her. We drive away Arayas: let Sunama seek the women-folk.

verses.sa:
यः कृष्णः केश्यसुर स्तम्बज उत तुण्डिकः ।
अरायानस्या मुष्काभ्यां भंससोप हन्मसि॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ keśyasura stambaja uta tuṇḍikaḥ arāyānasyā muṣkābhyāṃ bhaṃsasopa hanmasi
verses.en: The black and hairy Asura, and Stambaja and Tundika, Arfyas from this girl we drive, from bosom, waist, and parts below.

verses.sa:
अनुजिघ्रं प्रमृशन्तं क्रव्यादमुत रेरिहम्।
अरायांछ्वकिष्किणो बजः पिङ्गो अनीनशत्॥
verses.tr: anujighraṃ pramṛśantaṃ kravyādamuta reriham arāyāṃchvakiṣkiṇo bajaḥ piṅgo anīnaśat
verses.en: Sniffer, and Feeler, him who eats raw flesh, and him who licks his lips, Arayas with the tails of dogs, the yellow Baja hath destroyed.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा स्वप्ने निपद्यते भ्राता भूत्वा पितेव च ।
बजस्तान्त्सहतामितः क्लीबरूपांस्तिरीटिनः॥
verses.tr: yastvā svapne nipadyate bhrātā bhūtvā piteva ca bajastāntsahatāmitaḥ klībarūpāṃstirīṭinaḥ
verses.en: Whoever, in thy brother's shape or father's comes to thee in sleep,—Let Baja rout and chase them like eunuchs with woman's head-dress on.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा स्वपन्तीं त्सरति यस्त्वा दिप्सति जाग्रतीम्।
छायामिव प्र तान्त्सूर्यः परिक्रामन्ननीनशत्॥
verses.tr: yastvā svapantīṃ tsarati yastvā dipsati jāgratīm chāyāmiva pra tāntsūryaḥ parikrāmannanīnaśat
verses.en: Whoever steals to thee asleep or thinks to harm thee when awake,—These hath it banished, as the Sun travelling round drives shade away.

verses.sa:
यः कृणोति मृतवत्सामवतोकामिमां स्त्रियम्।
तमोषधे त्वं नाशयास्याः कमलमञ्जिवम्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kṛṇoti mṛtavatsāmavatokāmimāṃ striyam tamoṣadhe tvaṃ nāśayāsyāḥ kamalamañjivam
verses.en: Whoever causeth her to lose her child or bear untimely fruit,—Destroy him, O thou Plant, destroy the slippery fiend who lusts for her.

verses.sa:
ये शालाः परिनृत्यन्ति सायं गर्दभनादिनः ।
कुसूला ये च कुक्षिलाः ककुभाः करुमाः स्रिमाः ।
तानोषधे त्वं गन्धेन विषूचीनान् वि नाशय॥
verses.tr: ye śālāḥ parinṛtyanti sāyaṃ gardabhanādinaḥ kusūlā ye ca kukṣilāḥ kakubhāḥ karumāḥ srimāḥ tānoṣadhe tvaṃ gandhena viṣūcīnān vi nāśaya
verses.en: Those who at evening, with the bray of asses, dance around the house, Kukshilas, and Kusikas, and Kakubhas, Srimas, Karumas, These with thine odour, O thou Plant, drive far away to every side.

verses.sa:
ये कुकुन्धाः कुकूरभाः कृत्तीर्दूर्शानि बिभ्रति ।
क्लीबा इव प्रनृत्यन्तो वने ये कुर्वते घोषं तानितो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: ye kukundhāḥ kukūrabhāḥ kṛttīrdūrśāni bibhrati klībā iva pranṛtyanto vane ye kurvate ghoṣaṃ tānito nāśayāmasi
verses.en: Kukundhas and Kukurabhas who dress themselves in hides and skins, Who dance about like eunuchs, who raise a wild clamour in the wood, all these we banish far away.

verses.sa:
ये सूर्यं न तितिक्षन्त आतपन्तममुं दिवः ।
अरायान् बस्तवासिनो दुर्गन्धींल्लोहितास्यान् मककान् नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: ye sūryaṃ na titikṣanta ātapantamamuṃ divaḥ arāyān bastavāsino durgandhīṃllohitāsyān makakān nāśayāmasi
verses.en: All those who cannot bear the Sun who warms us yonder from the sky, Arayas with the smell of goats, malodorous, with bloody mouths, the Makakas we drive afar.

verses.sa:
य आत्मानमतिमात्रमंस आधाय बिभ्रति ।
स्त्रीणां श्रोणिप्रतोदिन इन्द्र रक्षांसि नाशय॥
verses.tr: ya ātmānamatimātramaṃsa ādhāya bibhrati strīṇāṃ śroṇipratodina indra rakṣāṃsi nāśaya
verses.en: All those who on their shoulders bear a head of monstrous magnitude, Who pierce the women's loins with pain,—those demons, Indra! drive away!

verses.sa:
ये पूर्वे बध्वो३यन्ति हस्ते शृङ्गाणि बिभ्रतः ।
आपाकेस्थाः प्रहासिन स्तम्बे ये कुर्वते ज्योतिस्तानितो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: ye pūrve badhvo3yanti haste śṛṅgāṇi bibhrataḥ āpākesthāḥ prahāsina stambe ye kurvate jyotistānito nāśayāmasi
verses.en: Those, bearing horns upon their hands, who first of all approach the brides; Standing in ovens, laughing loud, those who in bushes flash forth light, all these we banish hence away.

verses.sa:
येषां पश्चात् प्रपदानि पुरः पार्ष्णीः पुरो मुखा ।
खलजाः शकधूमजा उरुण्डा ये च मट्मटाः कुम्भमुष्का अयाशवः ।
तानस्या ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रतीबोधेन नाशय॥
verses.tr: yeṣāṃ paścāt prapadāni puraḥ pārṣṇīḥ puro mukhā khalajāḥ śakadhūmajā uruṇḍā ye ca maṭmaṭāḥ kumbhamuṣkā ayāśavaḥ tānasyā brahmaṇaspate pratībodhena nāśaya
verses.en: Those who have retroverted toes, and heels and faces in the front, Khalajas Sakadhumajas, Urundas, all the Matmatas, impotent Kumbhamushkas, these, Drive thou, O Brahmanaspati, far from this girl with vigilance.

verses.sa:
पर्यस्ताक्षा अप्रचङ्कशा अस्त्रैणाः सन्तु पण्डगाः ।
अव भेषज पादय य इमां संविवृत्सत्यपतिः स्वपतिं स्त्रियम्॥
verses.tr: paryastākṣā apracaṅkaśā astraiṇāḥ santu paṇḍagāḥ ava bheṣaja pādaya ya imāṃ saṃvivṛtsatyapatiḥ svapatiṃ striyam
verses.en: Sightless and with distorted eyes, impotent, woman-less be they. O Healing Plant, cast each away who, not her husband, would approach this woman wedded to her lord.

verses.sa:
उद्धर्षिणं मुनिकेशं जम्भयन्तं मरीमृशम्।
उपेषन्तमुदुम्बलं तुण्डेलमुत शालुडम्।
पदा प्र विध्य पार्ष्ण्या स्थालीं गौरिव स्पन्दना॥
verses.tr: uddharṣiṇaṃ munikeśaṃ jambhayantaṃ marīmṛśam upeṣantamudumbalaṃ tuṇḍelamuta śāluḍam padā pra vidhya pārṣṇyā sthālīṃ gauriva spandanā
verses.en: The Bristly-haired, the Maniac-haired, the Biter, and the Groper-fiend, The Creeper-near, the Copper-hued, the Snouty, and the Saluda, With foot and heel kick over, as a hasty cow her milking-pan.

verses.sa:
यस्ते गर्भं प्रतिमृशाज्जातं वा मारयाति ते ।
पिङ्गस्तमुग्रधन्वा कृणोतु हृदयाविधम्॥
verses.tr: yaste garbhaṃ pratimṛśājjātaṃ vā mārayāti te piṅgastamugradhanvā kṛṇotu hṛdayāvidham
verses.en: If one should touch thy coming babe or kill thine infant newly born, The yellow Plant with mighty bow shall pierce him even to the heart.

verses.sa:
ये अम्नो जातान् मारयन्ति सूतिका अनुशेरते ।
स्त्रीभागान् पिङ्गो गन्धर्वान् वातो अभ्रमिवाजतु॥
verses.tr: ye amno jātān mārayanti sūtikā anuśerate strībhāgān piṅgo gandharvān vāto abhramivājatu
verses.en: Those who kill infants unawares, and near the new-made mothers lie,—Let Pinga chase the amorous Gandharvas as wind chases cloud.

verses.sa:
परिसृष्टं धरयतु यद्धितं माव पादि तत्।
गर्भं त उग्रौ रक्षतां भेषजौ नीविभार्यौऽ॥
verses.tr: parisṛṣṭaṃ dharayatu yaddhitaṃ māva pādi tat garbhaṃ ta ugrau rakṣatāṃ bheṣajau nīvibhāryau'
verses.en: Let it maintain the genial seed: let the laid embryo rest secure. Let both strong Healers, to be worn within the girdle, guard the babe.

verses.sa:
पवीनसात् तङ्गल्वा३च्छायकादुत नग्नकात्।
प्रजायै पत्ये त्वा पिङ्गः परि पातु किमीदिनः॥
verses.tr: pavīnasāt taṅgalvā3cchāyakāduta nagnakāt prajāyai patye tvā piṅgaḥ pari pātu kimīdinaḥ
verses.en: From the Kimidin, for thy lord and children, Pinga shield thee well, From Sayaka, and Nagnaka, Tangalva, and Pavinasa.

verses.sa:
द्व्याऽस्याच्चतुरक्षात् पञ्चपदादनङ्गुरेः ।
वृन्तादभि प्रसर्पतः परि पाहि वरीवृतात्॥
verses.tr: dvyā'syāccaturakṣāt pañcapadādanaṅgureḥ vṛntādabhi prasarpataḥ pari pāhi varīvṛtāt
verses.en: From the five-footed, fingerless, from the four-eyed, the double-faced, i From the Close-creeper, from the Worm, from the Quick-roller guard her well.

verses.sa:
यआमं मांसमदन्ति पौरुषेयं च ये क्रविः ।
गर्भान् खादन्ति केशवास्तानितो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: yaāmaṃ māṃsamadanti pauruṣeyaṃ ca ye kraviḥ garbhān khādanti keśavāstānito nāśayāmasi
verses.en: Those who eat flesh uncooked, and those who eat the bleeding flesh of men, Feeders on babes unborn, long-haired, far from this place we banish these.

verses.sa:
ये सूर्यात् परिसर्पन्ति स्नुषेव श्वशुरादधि ।
बजश्च तेषां पिङ्गश्च हृदयेऽधि नि विध्यताम्॥
verses.tr: ye sūryāt parisarpanti snuṣeva śvaśurādadhi bajaśca teṣāṃ piṅgaśca hṛdaye'dhi ni vidhyatām
verses.en: Shy slinkers from the Sun, as slinks a woman from her husband's sire,—Deep down into the heart of these let Baja and let Pinga pierce.

verses.sa:
पिङ्ग रक्ष जायमानं मा पुमांसं स्त्रियं क्रन्।
आण्डादो गर्भान्मा दभन् बाधस्वेतः किमीदिनः॥
verses.tr: piṅga rakṣa jāyamānaṃ mā pumāṃsaṃ striyaṃ kran āṇḍādo garbhānmā dabhan bādhasvetaḥ kimīdinaḥ
verses.en: Pinga, preserve the babe at birth, make not the boy a female child. Let not Egg-eaters mar the germs: drive the Kimidins far away.

verses.sa:
अप्रजास्त्वं मार्तवत्समाद् रोदमघमावयम्।
वृक्षादिव स्रजं कृत्वाप्रिये प्रति मुञ्च तत्॥
verses.tr: aprajāstvaṃ mārtavatsamād rodamaghamāvayam vṛkṣādiva srajaṃ kṛtvāpriye prati muñca tat
verses.en: Sterility, and infants' death, and weeping that announceth woe,—Dear! lay them. on the fiend as thou wouldst pluck a garland from a tree.

sections.label: A charm to restore a sick man to health
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 7

verses.sa:
या बभ्रवो याश्च शुक्रा रोहिणीरुत पृश्नयः ।
असिक्नीः कृष्णा ओषधीः सर्वा अच्छावदामसि॥
verses.tr: yā babhravo yāśca śukrā rohiṇīruta pṛśnayaḥ asiknīḥ kṛṣṇā oṣadhīḥ sarvā acchāvadāmasi
verses.en: THe tawny-coloured, and the pale, the variegated, and the red, The dusky-tinted, and the black,—all Plants we summon hitherward.

verses.sa:
त्रायन्तामिमं पुरुषं यक्ष्माद् देवेषितादधि ।
यासां द्यौष्पिता पृथिवी माता समुद्रो मूलं वीरुधां बभूव॥
verses.tr: trāyantāmimaṃ puruṣaṃ yakṣmād deveṣitādadhi yāsāṃ dyauṣpitā pṛthivī mātā samudro mūlaṃ vīrudhāṃ babhūva
verses.en: This man let them deliver from Consumption which the Gods have sent. The father of these Herbs was Heaven, their mother Earth, the Sea their root.

verses.sa:
आपो अग्रं दिव्या ओषधयः ।
तास्ते यक्ष्ममेनस्य१मङ्गादङ्गादनीनशन्॥
verses.tr: āpo agraṃ divyā oṣadhayaḥ tāste yakṣmamenasya1maṅgādaṅgādanīnaśan
verses.en: The Waters are the best, and heavenly Plants: From every limb of thine have they removed Consumption caused by sin.

verses.sa:
प्रस्तृणती स्तम्बिनीरेकशुङ्गाः प्रतन्वतीरोषधीरा वदामि ।
अंशुमतीः काण्डिनीर्या विशाखा ह्वयामि ते वीरुधो वैश्वदेवीरुग्राः पुरुषजीवनीः॥
verses.tr: prastṛṇatī stambinīrekaśuṅgāḥ pratanvatīroṣadhīrā vadāmi aṃśumatīḥ kāṇḍinīryā viśākhā hvayāmi te vīrudho vaiśvadevīrugrāḥ puruṣajīvanīḥ
verses.en: I speak to Healing Herbs spreading, and bushy, to creepers, and to those whose sheath is single, I call for thee the fibrous and the reed-like, and branching Plants, dear to the Visve Devas, powerful, giving life to men.

verses.sa:
यद् वः सहः सहमाना वीर्यं१यच्च वो बलम्।
तेनेममस्माद् यक्ष्मात् पुरुषं मुञ्चतौषधीरथो कृणोमि भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: yad vaḥ sahaḥ sahamānā vīryaṃ1yacca vo balam tenemamasmād yakṣmāt puruṣaṃ muñcatauṣadhīratho kṛṇomi bheṣajam
verses.en: The conquering strength, the power and might which ye, victorious Plants, possess, Therewith deliver this in in here from this Consumption, O ye Plants: so I prepare the remedy.

verses.sa:
जीवलां नघारिषां जीवन्तीमोषधीमहम्।
अरुन्धतीमुन्नयन्तीं पुष्पां मधुमतीमिह हुवेऽस्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: jīvalāṃ naghāriṣāṃ jīvantīmoṣadhīmaham arundhatīmunnayantīṃ puṣpāṃ madhumatīmiha huve'smā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: The living Plant that giveth life, that driveth malady away, Arundhati, the rescuer, strengthening, rich in sweets I call, to free this man from scath and harm.

verses.sa:
इहा यन्तु प्रचेतसो मेदिनीर्वचसो मम ।
यथेमं पारयामसि पुरुषं दुरितादधि॥
verses.tr: ihā yantu pracetaso medinīrvacaso mama yathemaṃ pārayāmasi puruṣaṃ duritādadhi
verses.en: Hitherward let the sapient come, the friendly sharers of my speech, That we may give this man relief and raise him from his evil plight.

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्घासो अपां गर्भो या रोहन्ति पुनर्णवाः ।
ध्रुवाः सहस्रनाम्नीर्भेषजीः सन्त्वाभृताः॥
verses.tr: agnerghāso apāṃ garbho yā rohanti punarṇavāḥ dhruvāḥ sahasranāmnīrbheṣajīḥ santvābhṛtāḥ
verses.en: Germ of the Waters, Agni's food, Plants ever growing fresh and new, Sure, healing, bearing thousand names, let them be all collected here.

verses.sa:
अवकोल्बा उदकात्मान ओषधयः ।
व्यृऽषन्तु दुरितं तीक्ष्णशृङ्ग्यः॥
verses.tr: avakolbā udakātmāna oṣadhayaḥ vyṛ'ṣantu duritaṃ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgyaḥ
verses.en: Let Plants whose soul is water, girt with Avakas, piercing with their sharp horns expel the malady.

verses.sa:
उन्मुञ्चन्तीर्विवरुणा उग्रा या विषदूषणीः ।
अथो बलासनाशनीः कृत्यादूषणीश्च यास्ता इहा यन्त्वोषधीः॥
verses.tr: unmuñcantīrvivaruṇā ugrā yā viṣadūṣaṇīḥ atho balāsanāśanīḥ kṛtyādūṣaṇīśca yāstā ihā yantvoṣadhīḥ
verses.en: Strong, antidotes of poison, those releasers, free from Varuna, And those that drive away Catarrh, and those that frustrate magic arts, let all those Plants come hitherward.

verses.sa:
अपक्रीताः सहीयसीर्वीरुधो या अभिष्टुताः ।
त्रायन्तामस्मिन् ग्रामे गामश्वं पुरुषं पशुम्॥
verses.tr: apakrītāḥ sahīyasīrvīrudho yā abhiṣṭutāḥ trāyantāmasmin grāme gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum
verses.en: Let purchased Plants of mightier power, Plants that are praised for excellence, Here in this village safely keep cattle and horses, man and beast.

verses.sa:
मधुमन्मूलं मधुमदग्रमासाम्मधुमन्मध्यं वीरुधां बभूव ।
मधुमत् पर्णं मधुमत् पुष्पमासां मधोः संभक्ता अमृतस्य भक्षो घृतमन्नं दुह्रतां गोपुरोगवम्॥
verses.tr: madhumanmūlaṃ madhumadagramāsāmmadhumanmadhyaṃ vīrudhāṃ babhūva madhumat parṇaṃ madhumat puṣpamāsāṃ madhoḥ saṃbhaktā amṛtasya bhakṣo ghṛtamannaṃ duhratāṃ gopurogavam
verses.en: Sweet is their root, sweet are these Plants' top branches, sweet also is their intermediate portion. Sweet is their foliage, and sweet their blossom, combined with sweetness is their taste of Amrit: food, fatness let them yield, with kine preceding.

verses.sa:
यावतीः कियतीश्चेमाः पृथिव्यामध्योषधीः ।
ता मा सहस्रपर्ण्योऽ मृत्योर्मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yāvatīḥ kiyatīścemāḥ pṛthivyāmadhyoṣadhīḥ tā mā sahasraparṇyo' mṛtyormuñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: These Plants that grow upon the earth, whatever their number and their size,—Let these with all their thousand leaves free me from Death and misery.

verses.sa:
वैयाघ्रो मणिर्वीरुधां त्रायमानोऽभिशस्तिपाः ।
अमीवाः सर्वा रक्षांस्यप हन्त्वधि दूरमस्मत्॥
verses.tr: vaiyāghro maṇirvīrudhāṃ trāyamāno'bhiśastipāḥ amīvāḥ sarvā rakṣāṃsyapa hantvadhi dūramasmat
verses.en: May the Plants' Tiger-amulet, protective, guardian from the curse, Beat off the brood of demons, drive all maladies afar from us.

verses.sa:
सिंहस्येव स्तनथोः सं विजन्तेऽग्नेरिव विजन्त आभृताभ्यः ।
गवां यक्ष्मः पुरुषाणां वीरुद्भिरतिनुत्तो नाव्याऽएतु स्रोत्याः॥
verses.tr: siṃhasyeva stanathoḥ saṃ vijante'gneriva vijanta ābhṛtābhyaḥ gavāṃ yakṣmaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ vīrudbhiratinutto nāvyā'etu srotyāḥ
verses.en: Before the gathered Plants they fly and scatter, as though a lion's roar or fire dismayed them. Expelled by Plants, let men's and kine's Consumption pass from us to the navigable rivers.

verses.sa:
मुमुचाना ओषधयोऽग्नेर्वैश्वानरादधि ।
भूमिं संतन्वतीरित यासां राजा वनस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: mumucānā oṣadhayo'gnervaiśvānarādadhi bhūmiṃ saṃtanvatīrita yāsāṃ rājā vanaspatiḥ
verses.en: Emancipated from the sway of Agni, of Vaisvanara, go, covering the earth, ye Plants whose ruler is Vanaspati.

verses.sa:
या रोहन्त्याङ्गिरसीः पर्वतेषु समेषु च ।
ता नः पयस्वतीः शिवा ओषधीः सन्तु शं हृदे॥
verses.tr: yā rohantyāṅgirasīḥ parvateṣu sameṣu ca tā naḥ payasvatīḥ śivā oṣadhīḥ santu śaṃ hṛde
verses.en: May these be pleasant to our heart, auspicious, rich in store of milk, These Plants of the Angirases which grow on mountains and on plains.

verses.sa:
याश्चाहं वेद वीरुधो याश्च पश्यामि चक्षुषा ।
अज्ञाता जानीमश्च या यासु विद्म च संभृतम्॥
verses.tr: yāścāhaṃ veda vīrudho yāśca paśyāmi cakṣuṣā ajñātā jānīmaśca yā yāsu vidma ca saṃbhṛtam
verses.en: The Plants I know myself, the plants that with: mine eye I look upon, Plants yet unknown, and those we know, wherein we find that power is stored,

verses.sa:
सर्वाः समग्रा ओषधीर्बोधन्तु वचसो मम ।
यथेमं पारयामसि पुरुषं दुरितादधि॥
verses.tr: sarvāḥ samagrā oṣadhīrbodhantu vacaso mama yathemaṃ pārayāmasi puruṣaṃ duritādadhi
verses.en: Let all the congregated Plants attend and mark mine utterance, That we may rescue this man here and save him from severe distress.

verses.sa:
अश्वत्थो दर्भो वीरुधां सोमो राजामृतं हविः ।
व्रीहिर्यवश्च भेषजौ दिवस्पुत्रावमर्त्यौ॥
verses.tr: aśvattho darbho vīrudhāṃ somo rājāmṛtaṃ haviḥ vrīhiryavaśca bheṣajau divasputrāvamartyau
verses.en: Asvattha, Darbha, King of Plants, is. Soma, deathless sacrifice: Barley and Rice are healing balms, the sons of Heaven who never die. Tiger-amulet an exceedingly potent charm.

verses.sa:
उज्जिहीध्वे स्तनयत्यभिक्रन्दत्योषधीः ।
यदा वः पृश्निमातरः पर्जन्यो रेतसावति॥
verses.tr: ujjihīdhve stanayatyabhikrandatyoṣadhīḥ yadā vaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ parjanyo retasāvati
verses.en: Lift yourselves up, ye Healing Plants, loud is the thunder's crash and roar. When with full flow Parjanya, ye Children of Prisni! blesseth you.

verses.sa:
तस्यामृतस्येमं बलं पुरुषं पाययामसि ।
अथो कृणोमि भेषजं यथा सच्छतहायनः॥
verses.tr: tasyāmṛtasyemaṃ balaṃ puruṣaṃ pāyayāmasi atho kṛṇomi bheṣajaṃ yathā sacchatahāyanaḥ
verses.en: We give the essence of that stream of nectar to this man to drink: So I prepare a remedy that he may live a hundred years.

verses.sa:
वराहो वेद वीरुधं नकुलो वेद भेषजीम्।
सर्पा गन्धर्वा या विदुस्ता अस्मा अवसे हुवे॥
verses.tr: varāho veda vīrudhaṃ nakulo veda bheṣajīm sarpā gandharvā yā vidustā asmā avase huve
verses.en: Well doth the wild boar know a Plant, the mungoose knows the Healing Herb. I call, to aid this man, the Plants which Serpents and Gandharvas know.

verses.sa:
याः सुपर्णा आङ्गिरसीर्दिव्या या रघतो विदुः ।
वयांसि हंसा या विदुर्याश्च सर्वे पतत्रिणः ।
मृगा या विदुरोषधीस्ता अस्मा अवसे हुवे॥
verses.tr: yāḥ suparṇā āṅgirasīrdivyā yā raghato viduḥ vayāṃsi haṃsā yā viduryāśca sarve patatriṇaḥ mṛgā yā viduroṣadhīstā asmā avase huve
verses.en: Plants of Angirases which hawks, celestial Plants which eagles know; Plants known to swans and lesser fowl, Plants known to all the birds that fly, Plants that are known to sylvan beasts,—I call them all to aid this man.

verses.sa:
यावतीनामोषधीनां गावः प्राश्नन्त्यघ्न्या यावतीनामजावयः ।
तावतीस्तुभ्यमोषधीः शर्म यच्छन्त्वाभृताः॥
verses.tr: yāvatīnāmoṣadhīnāṃ gāvaḥ prāśnantyaghnyā yāvatīnāmajāvayaḥ tāvatīstubhyamoṣadhīḥ śarma yacchantvābhṛtāḥ
verses.en: The multitude of herbs whereon the Cows whom none may slaughter feed, all that are food for goats and sheep, So many Plants, brought hitherward, give shelter and defence to thee!

verses.sa:
यावतीषु मनुष्याऽ भेषजं भिषजो विदुः ।
तावतीर्विश्वभेषजीरा भरामि त्वामभि॥
verses.tr: yāvatīṣu manuṣyā' bheṣajaṃ bhiṣajo viduḥ tāvatīrviśvabheṣajīrā bharāmi tvāmabhi
verses.en: Hitherward unto thee I bring the Plants that cure all maladies, All Plants wherein physicians have discovered health-bestowing power.

verses.sa:
पुष्पवतीः प्रसूमतीः फलिनीरफला उत।
संमातर इव दुह्रामस्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: puṣpavatīḥ prasūmatīḥ phalinīraphalā uta saṃmātara iva duhrāmasmā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Let Plants with flower and Plants with bud, the fruitful and the fruitless, all, Like children of one mother, yield their stores for this man's perfect health.

verses.sa:
उत् त्वाहार्षं पञ्चशलादथो दशशलादुत।
अथो यमस्य पड्वीशाद् विश्वस्माद् देवकिल्बिषात्॥
verses.tr: ut tvāhārṣaṃ pañcaśalādatho daśaśalāduta atho yamasya paḍvīśād viśvasmād devakilbiṣāt
verses.en: From the Five-atrowed, from the Ten-arrowed have I delivered thee, Freed thee from Yama's fetter and from all offence against the Gods.

sections.label: Imprecations directed against a hostile army
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 8

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मन्थतु मन्थिता शक्रः शूरः पुरंदरः ।
यथा हनाम सेना अमित्राणां सहस्रशः॥
verses.tr: indro manthatu manthitā śakraḥ śūraḥ puraṃdaraḥ yathā hanāma senā amitrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ
verses.en: Indra the Shaker shake them up, brave, hero, fort-demolisher, That into thousand fragments we may strike the armies of our foes!

verses.sa:
पूतिरज्जुरुपध्मानी पूतिं सेनां कृणोत्वमूम्।
धूममग्निं परादृश्यामित्रा हृत्स्वा दधतां भयम्॥
verses.tr: pūtirajjurupadhmānī pūtiṃ senāṃ kṛṇotvamūm dhūmamagniṃ parādṛśyāmitrā hṛtsvā dadhatāṃ bhayam
verses.en: Let Putirajju with her breath corrupt and putrefy that host, And terror smite our foemen's heart when fire and smoke are seen afar.

verses.sa:
अमूनश्वत्थ निः शृणीहि खादामून् खदिराजिरम्।
ताजद्भङ्ग इव भजन्तां हन्त्वेनान् वधको वधैः॥
verses.tr: amūnaśvattha niḥ śṛṇīhi khādāmūn khadirājiram tājadbhaṅga iva bhajantāṃ hantvenān vadhako vadhaiḥ
verses.en: Asvattha, rend those men; do thou devour them quickly, Khadira! Like reeds let them be broken through, down-smitten by a lifted rush.

verses.sa:
परुषानमून् परुषाह्वः कृणोतु हन्त्वेनान् वधको वधैः ।
क्षिप्रं शर इव भजन्तां बृहज्जालेन संदिताः॥
verses.tr: paruṣānamūn paruṣāhvaḥ kṛṇotu hantvenān vadhako vadhaiḥ kṣipraṃ śara iva bhajantāṃ bṛhajjālena saṃditāḥ
verses.en: Let Parushahva make them reeds, and let the bulrush strike them down; Bound i in a mighty net let them break quickly like an arrow's shaft.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षं जालमासीज्जालदण्डा दिशो महीः ।
तेनाभिधाय दस्यूनां शक्रः सेनामपावपत्॥
verses.tr: antarikṣaṃ jālamāsījjāladaṇḍā diśo mahīḥ tenābhidhāya dasyūnāṃ śakraḥ senāmapāvapat
verses.en: Air was the net; the poles thereof were the great quarters of the sky: Sakra therewith enveloped and cast on the ground the Dasyus' host.

verses.sa:
बृहद्धि जालं बृहतः शक्रस्य वाजिनीवतः ।
तेन शत्रूनभि सर्वान् न्युऽब्ज यथा न मुच्यातै कतमश्चनैषाम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaddhi jālaṃ bṛhataḥ śakrasya vājinīvataḥ tena śatrūnabhi sarvān nyu'bja yathā na mucyātai katamaścanaiṣām
verses.en: Verily mighty is the net of mighty Sakra rich in wealth: Therewith press all the foemen down so that not one of them escape!

verses.sa:
बृहत् ते जालं बृहत इन्द्र शूर सहस्रार्घस्य शतवीर्यस्य ।
तेन शतं सहस्रमयुतं न्यऽर्बुदं जघान शक्रो दस्यूनामभिधाय सेनया॥
verses.tr: bṛhat te jālaṃ bṛhata indra śūra sahasrārghasya śatavīryasya tena śataṃ sahasramayutaṃ nya'rbudaṃ jaghāna śakro dasyūnāmabhidhāya senayā
verses.en: Great is thy net, brave Indra, thine the mighty, match for a thousand, Lord of Hundred Powers! Holding. them, with his host, therewith hath Indra slaughtered Dasyus a hundred) thousand, myriad, hundred millions.

verses.sa:
अयं लोको जालमासीच्छक्रस्य महतो महान्।
तेनाहमिन्द्रजालेनामूंस्तमसाभि दधामि सर्वान्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ loko jālamāsīcchakrasya mahato mahān tenāhamindrajālenāmūṃstamasābhi dadhāmi sarvān
verses.en: This world so mighty was the net of Sakra, of the Mighty One: With this, the net of Indra, I envelop all those men with gloom.

verses.sa:
सेदिरुग्रा व्यृऽद्धिरार्तिश्चानपवाचना।
श्रमस्तन्द्रीश्च मोहश्च तैरमूनभि दधामि सर्वान्॥
verses.tr: sedirugrā vyṛ'ddhirārtiścānapavācanā śramastandrīśca mohaśca tairamūnabhi dadhāmi sarvān
verses.en: Great weakness and misfortune, pain which words can never charm away, Languor, fatigue, bewilderment, with these I compass all the foes.

verses.sa:
मृत्यवेऽमून् प्र यच्छामि मृत्युपाशैरमी सिताः ।
मृत्योर्ये अघला दूतास्तेभ्य एनान् प्रति नयामि बद्ध्वा॥
verses.tr: mṛtyave'mūn pra yacchāmi mṛtyupāśairamī sitāḥ mṛtyorye aghalā dūtāstebhya enān prati nayāmi baddhvā
verses.en: I give those foemen up to Death: bound in the bonds of Death are they. I bind and carry them away to meet Death's wicked messengers.

verses.sa:
नयतामून् मृत्युदूता यमदूता अपोम्भत ।
परःसहस्रा हन्यन्तां तृणेढ्वेनान् मत्यं भवस्य॥
verses.tr: nayatāmūn mṛtyudūtā yamadūtā apombhata paraḥsahasrā hanyantāṃ tṛṇeḍhvenān matyaṃ bhavasya
verses.en: Bear them away, Death's messengers! envoys of Yama! bind them fast. More than a thousand be their slain: the club of Bhava pierce them through!

verses.sa:
साध्या एकं जालदण्डमुद्यत्य यन्त्योजसा ।
रुद्रा एकं वसव एकमादित्यैरेक उद्यतः॥
verses.tr: sādhyā ekaṃ jāladaṇḍamudyatya yantyojasā rudrā ekaṃ vasava ekamādityaireka udyataḥ
verses.en: Forth go the Sadhyas in their might bearing one net-pole raised aloft. One pole the Rudras carry, one the Vasus, and the Adityas one.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवाः उपरिष्टादुब्जन्तो यन्त्वोजसा ।
मध्येन घ्नन्तो यन्तु सेनामङ्गिरसो महीम्॥
verses.tr: viśve devāḥ upariṣṭādubjanto yantvojasā madhyena ghnanto yantu senāmaṅgiraso mahīm
verses.en: The Visve Devas from above shall come depressing it with might, And in the midst the Angirases, slaying the mighty host, shall go.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतीन् वानस्पत्यानोषधीरुत वीरुधः ।
द्विपाच्चतुष्पादिष्णामि यथा सेनाममूं हनन्॥
verses.tr: vanaspatīn vānaspatyānoṣadhīruta vīrudhaḥ dvipāccatuṣpādiṣṇāmi yathā senāmamūṃ hanan
verses.en: Trees of the forest, trees that bear flower and fruit, and herbs and plants, Quadruped, biped send I forth that they may strike this army dead.

verses.sa:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सर्पान् देवान् पुण्यजनान् पितॄन्।
दृष्टानदृष्टानिष्णामि यथा सेनाममूं हनन्॥
verses.tr: gandharvāpsarasaḥ sarpān devān puṇyajanān pitṝn dṛṣṭānadṛṣṭāniṣṇāmi yathā senāmamūṃ hanan
verses.en: Gandharvas, and Apsarases, Gods, Serpents, Fathers, Holy Men, Seen and unseen, I send them forth that they may strike this army dead.

verses.sa:
इम उप्ता मृत्युपाशा यानाक्रम्य न मुच्यसे ।
अमुष्या हन्तु सेनाया इदं कूटं सहस्रशः॥
verses.tr: ima uptā mṛtyupāśā yānākramya na mucyase amuṣyā hantu senāyā idaṃ kūṭaṃ sahasraśaḥ
verses.en: Here spread are snares of Death wherefrom thou, once within them, ne'er art freed: Full many a thousand of the host yonder this horn shall smite and slay.

verses.sa:
घर्मः समिद्धो अग्निनायं होमः सहस्रहः ।
भवश्च पृश्निबाहुश्च शर्व सेनाममूं हतम्॥
verses.tr: gharmaḥ samiddho agnināyaṃ homaḥ sahasrahaḥ bhavaśca pṛśnibāhuśca śarva senāmamūṃ hatam
verses.en: The Gharma hath been warmed with fire: this Homa slays a thousand men. Let Bhava, Prisnibahu, and Sarva destroy that armament.

verses.sa:
मृत्योराषमा पद्यन्तां क्षुधं सेदिं वधं भयम्।
इन्द्रश्चाक्षुजालाभ्यां शर्व सेनाममूं हतम्॥
verses.tr: mṛtyorāṣamā padyantāṃ kṣudhaṃ sediṃ vadhaṃ bhayam indraścākṣujālābhyāṃ śarva senāmamūṃ hatam
verses.en: Their portion be the fire of Death, hunger, exhaustion, slaughter, fear. With your entangling snares and nets, Sarva and Indra! slay that host.

verses.sa:
पराजिताः प्र त्रसतामित्रा नुत्ता धावत ब्रह्मणा ।
बृहस्पतिप्रनुत्तानां मामीषां मोचि कश्चन॥
verses.tr: parājitāḥ pra trasatāmitrā nuttā dhāvata brahmaṇā bṛhaspatipranuttānāṃ māmīṣāṃ moci kaścana
verses.en: Fly, conquered, in alarm, ye foes, run driven by the spell away! Let not one man escape of those when routed by Brihaspati.

verses.sa:
अव पद्यन्तामेषामायुधानि मा शकन् प्रतिधामिषुम्।
अथैषां बहु बिभ्यतामिषवः घ्नन्तु मर्मणि॥
verses.tr: ava padyantāmeṣāmāyudhāni mā śakan pratidhāmiṣum athaiṣāṃ bahu bibhyatāmiṣavaḥ ghnantu marmaṇi
verses.en: Down fall their weapons on the ground: no strength be theirs to point a shaft: Then in their dreadful terror let their arrows wound their vital parts.

verses.sa:
सं क्रोशतामेनान् द्यावापृथिवी समन्तरिक्षं सह देवताभिः ।
मा ज्ञातारं मा प्रतिष्ठां विदन्त मिथो विघ्नाना उप यन्तु मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ krośatāmenān dyāvāpṛthivī samantarikṣaṃ saha devatābhiḥ mā jñātāraṃ mā pratiṣṭhāṃ vidanta mitho vighnānā upa yantu mṛtyum
verses.en: Let Heaven and Earth roar out in wrath against them, and Air with all the Deities in concert. Let them not find a surety or a refuge, but torn away go down to Death together.

verses.sa:
दिशश्चतस्रोऽश्वतर्यो देवरथस्य पुरोडाशाः शफा अन्तरिक्षमुद्धिः ।
द्यावापृथिवी पक्षसी ऋतवोऽभीशवोऽन्तर्देशाः किंकरा वाक् परिरथ्यम्॥
verses.tr: diśaścatasro'śvataryo devarathasya puroḍāśāḥ śaphā antarikṣamuddhiḥ dyāvāpṛthivī pakṣasī ṛtavo'bhīśavo'ntardeśāḥ kiṃkarā vāk parirathyam
verses.en: The mules of the Gods' car are heaven's four quarters; their hooves are sacred cakes, the air its body. Its sides are Heaven and Earth, its reins the Seasons, Voice is its hood, its grooms are sky's mid-regions.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरो रथः परिवत्सरो रथोपस्थो विराडीषाग्नी रथमुखम्।
इन्द्रः सव्यष्ठाश्चन्द्रमाः सारथिः॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsaro rathaḥ parivatsaro rathopastho virāḍīṣāgnī rathamukham indraḥ savyaṣṭhāścandramāḥ sārathiḥ
verses.en: Year is the car, Full Year the seat for driving, Viraj the pole, the chariot's front is Agni, Indra the warrior, and the Moon the driver.

verses.sa:
इतो जयेतो वि जय सं जय जय स्वाहा ।
इमे जयन्तु परामी जयन्तां स्वाहैभ्यो दुराहामीभ्यः ।
नीललोहितेनामूनभ्यवतनोमि॥
verses.tr: ito jayeto vi jaya saṃ jaya jaya svāhā ime jayantu parāmī jayantāṃ svāhaibhyo durāhāmībhyaḥ nīlalohitenāmūnabhyavatanomi
verses.en: Hence conquer, conquer, Hail! be thou the victor! Let these be conquerors and those be conquered. Good luck to these, ill luck to those men yonder! With the dark-blue-and-red our foes I cover.

sections.label: An enunciation of R ritual, and START doctrine
sections.name: Book 8, hymn 9

verses.sa:
कुतस्तौ जातौ कतमः सो अर्धः कस्माल्लोकात् कतमस्याः पृथिव्याः ।
वत्सौ विराजः सलिलादुदैतां तौ त्वा पृछामि कतरेण दुग्धा॥
verses.tr: kutastau jātau katamaḥ so ardhaḥ kasmāllokāt katamasyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ vatsau virājaḥ salilādudaitāṃ tau tvā pṛchāmi katareṇa dugdhā
